pli-tv-kd6:1.1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-kd6:1.1.2: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhūnaṃ sāradikena ābādhena phuṭṭhānaṃ yāgu pi pītā uggacchati bhattam pi bhuttaṃ uggacchati,
pli-tv-kd6:1.1.3: te tena kisā honti lūkhā dubbaṇṇā uppaṇḍuppaṇḍukajātā dhamani- santhatagattā.
pli-tv-kd6:1.1.4: addasa kho bhagavā te bhikkhū kise lūkhe dubbaṇṇe uppaṇḍuppaṇḍukajāte dhamanisanthatagatte, disvāna āyasmantaṃ Ānandaṃ āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd6:1.1.5: kiṃ nu kho Ānanda etarahi bhikkhū kisā lūkhā . . . dhamanisanthatagatte 'ti.
pli-tv-kd6:1.1.6: etarahi bhante bhikkhūnaṃ sāradikena ābādhena phuṭṭhānaṃ yāgu pi pītā uggacchati bhattam pi bhuttaṃ uggacchati,
pli-tv-kd6:1.1.7: te tena kisā lūkhā dubbaṇṇā uppaṇḍuppaṇḍukajātā dhamanisanthatagattā 'ti. ||1||
pli-tv-kd6:1.2.1: atha kho bhagavato rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi:
pli-tv-kd6:1.2.2: etarahi kho bhikkhūnaṃ sāradikena ābādhena phuṭṭhānaṃ --la--
pli-tv-kd6:1.2.4: kiṃ nu kho ahaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ bhesajjaṃ anujāneyyaṃ, yaṃ bhesajjañ c' eva assa bhesajjasammatañ ca lokassa āhārattañ ca phareyya na ca oḷāriko āhāro paññāyeyyā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd6:1.2.6: imāni kho pañca bhesajjāni seyyath' īdaṃ
pli-tv-kd6:1.2.8: bhesajjāni c' eva bhesajjasammatāni ca lokassa āhārattañ ca pharanti na ca oḷāriko āhāro paññāyati.
pli-tv-kd6:1.2.9: yaṃ nūnāhaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ imāni pañca bhesajjāni anujāneyyaṃ kāle paṭiggahetvā kāle paribhuñjitun ti. ||2||
pli-tv-kd6:1.3.1: atha kho bhagavā sāyaṇhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito etasmiṃ nidāne dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd6:1.3.10: bhikkhūnaṃ imāni pañca bhesajjāni anujāneyyaṃ kāle paṭiggahetvā kāle paribhuñjitun ti.
pli-tv-kd6:1.3.11: anujānāmi bhikkhave tāni pañca bhesajjāni kāle paṭiggahetvā kāle paribhuñjitun ti. ||3||
pli-tv-kd6:1.4.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū tāni pañca bhesajjāni kāle paṭiggahetvā kāle paribhuñjanti.
pli-tv-kd6:1.4.2: tesaṃ yāni pi tāni pākatikāni lūkhāni bhojanāni tāni pi na cchādenti, pag eva senesikāni.
pli-tv-kd6:1.4.3: te tena c' eva sāradikena ābādhena phuṭṭhā iminā ca bhattācchandakena tadubhayena bhiyyosomattāya kisā honti lūkhā dubbaṇṇā uppaṇḍuppaṇḍukajātā dhamanisanthatagattā.
pli-tv-kd6:1.4.4: addasa kho bhagavā te bhikkhū bhiyyosomattāya --la-- dhamanisanthatagatte, disvāna āyasmantaṃ Ānandaṃ āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd6:1.4.5: kiṃ nu kho Ānanda etarahi bhikkhū bhiyyosomattāya kisā --la-- dhamanisanthatagattā 'ti. ||4||
pli-tv-kd6:1.5.1: etarahi bhante bhikkhū tāni ca pañca bhesajjāni kāle . . .
pli-tv-kd6:1.5.3: tadubhayena bhiyyosomattāya kisā lūkhā dubbaṇṇā uppaṇḍuppaṇḍukajātā dhamanisanthatagattā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd6:1.5.4: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd6:1.5.5: anujānāmi bhikkhave tāni pañca bhesajjāni paṭiggahetvā kāle pi vikāle pi paribhuñjitun ti. ||5||1||
pli-tv-kd6:2.1.1: tena kho pana samayena gilānānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ vasehi bhesajjehi attho hoti.
pli-tv-kd6:2.1.5: kāle paṭiggahitaṃ kāle nipakkaṃ kāle saṃsaṭṭhaṃ telaparibhogena paribhuñjituṃ. ||1||
pli-tv-kd6:2.2.1: vikāle ce bhikkhave paṭiggahitaṃ, vikāle nipakkaṃ, vikāle saṃsaṭṭhaṃ, taṃ ce paribhuñjeyya, āpatti tiṇṇaṃ dukkaṭānaṃ.
pli-tv-kd6:2.2.2: kāle ce bhikkhave paṭiggahitaṃ, vikāle nipakkaṃ, vikāle saṃsaṭṭhaṃ, taṃ ce paribhuñjeyya, āpatti dvinnaṃ dukkaṭānaṃ.
pli-tv-kd6:2.2.3: kāle ce bhikkhave paṭiggahitaṃ, kāle nipakkaṃ, vikāle saṃsaṭṭhaṃ, taṃ ce paribhuñjeyya, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-kd6:2.2.4: kāle ce bhikkhave paṭiggahitaṃ, kāle nipakkaṃ, kāle saṃsaṭṭhaṃ, taṃ ce paribhuñjeyya, anāpattīti. ||2||2||
pli-tv-kd6:3.1.1: tena kho pana samayena gilānānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ mūlehi bhesajjehi attho hoti.
pli-tv-kd6:3.1.4: haliddaṃ siṅgiveraṃ vacaṃ vacatthaṃ ativisaṃ kaṭukarohiṇiṃ usīraṃ bhaddamuttakaṃ yāni vā pan' aññāni pi atthi mūlāni bhesajjāni, n' eva khādaniye khādaniyattaṃ pharanti, na bhojaniye bhojaniyattaṃ pharanti, tāni
pli-tv-kd6:3.2.1: tena kho pana samayena gilānānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ mūlehi bhesajjehi piṭṭhehi attho hoti.
pli-tv-kd6:4.1.1: tena kho pana samayena gilānānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ kasāvehi bhesajjehi attho hoti.
pli-tv-kd6:4.1.4: nimbakasāvaṃ kuṭajak. pakkavak. nattamālak. yāni vā pan' aññāni pi atthi kasāvabhesajjāni, n' eva khādaniye khādaniyattaṃ pharanti na bhojaniye bhojaniyattaṃ pharanti, tāni
pli-tv-kd6:5.1.1: tena kho pana samayena gilānānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ paṇṇehi bhesajjehi attho hoti.
pli-tv-kd6:5.1.4: nimbapaṇṇaṃ kuṭajap. paṭolap. sulasip. kappāsikap. yāni vā pan' aññāni pi atthi paṇṇāni bhesajjāni, n' eva khādaniye khādaniyattaṃ pharanti na bhojaniye bhojaniyattaṃ pharanti --
pli-tv-kd6:6.1.1: tena kho pana samayena gilānānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ phalehi bhesajjehi attho hoti
pli-tv-kd6:6.1.4: vilaṅgaṃ pippalaṃ maricaṃ harītakaṃ vibhītakaṃ āmalakaṃ goṭhaphalaṃ yāni vā pan' aññāni pi atthi phalāni bhesajjāni, n' eva khādaniye khādaniyattaṃ pharanti, na bhojaniye bhojaniyattaṃ pharanti
pli-tv-kd6:7.1.1: tena kho pana samayena gilānānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ jatūhi bhesajjehi attho hoti
pli-tv-kd6:7.1.4: hiṅgu hiṅgujatu hiṅgusipāṭikaṃ takaṃ takapattiṃ takapaṇṇiṃ sajjulasaṃ yāni vā pan' aññāni pi atthi jatūni bhesajjāni, n' eva khādaniye khādaniyattaṃ pharanti --
pli-tv-kd6:8.1.1: tena kho pana samayena gilānānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ loṇehi bhesajjehi attho hoti
pli-tv-kd6:8.1.4: sāmuddaṃ kāḷaloṇaṃ sindhavaṃ ubbhidaṃ bilaṃ yāni vā pan' aññāni pi atthi loṇāni bhesajjāni, n' eva khādaniye khādaniyattaṃ pharanti, na bhojaniye bhojaniyattaṃ pharanti, tāni
pli-tv-kd6:9.1.1: tena kho pana samayena āyasmato Ānandassa upajjhāyassa āyasmato Belaṭṭhasīsassa thullakacchābādho hoti.
pli-tv-kd6:9.1.2: tassa lasikāya cīvarāni kāye lagganti. tāni bhikkhū udakena temetvā-temetvā apakaḍḍhanti.
pli-tv-kd6:9.1.3: addasa kho bhagavā senāsanacārikaṃ āhiṇḍanto te bhikkhū tāni cīvarāni udakena temetvā-temetvā apakaḍḍhante, disvāna yena te bhikkhū ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā te bhikkhū etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd6:9.1.5: imassa bhante āyasmato thullakacchābādho, lasikāya cīvarāni kāye lagganti, tāni mayaṃ udakena temetvā-temetvā apakaḍḍhāmā 'ti. ||1||
pli-tv-kd6:9.2.1: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne dhammikathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd6:9.2.2: anujānāmi bhikkhave yassa kaṇḍu vā piḷakā vā assāvo vā thullakacchā vā ābādho kāyo vā duggandho, cuṇṇāni bhesajjāni,
pli-tv-kd6:10.1.1: tena kho pana samayena gilānānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ cuṇṇehi bhesajjehi cālitehi attho hoti
pli-tv-kd6:10.2.1: tena kho pana samayena aññatarassa bhikkhuno amanussikābādho hoti.
pli-tv-kd6:10.2.2: taṃ ācariyupajjhāyā upaṭṭhahantā nāsakkhiṃsu ārogaṃ kātuṃ.
pli-tv-kd6:10.2.3: so sūkarasūnaṃ gantvā āmakamaṃsaṃ khādi āmakalohitaṃ pivi,
pli-tv-kd6:10.2.6: anujānāmi bhikkhave amanussikābādhe āmakamaṃsaṃ āmakalohitan ti. ||2||10||
pli-tv-kd6:11.1.1: tena kho pana samayena aññatarassa bhikkhuno cakkhurogābādho hoti.
pli-tv-kd6:11.1.2: taṃ bhikkhuṃ pariggahetvā uccāram pi passāvam pi nikkhāmenti.
pli-tv-kd6:11.1.3: addasa kho bhagavā senāsanacārikaṃ āhiṇḍanto te bhikkhū taṃ bhikkhuṃ pariggahetvā uccāram pi passāvam pi nikkhāmente, disvāna yena te bhikkhū ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā te bhikkhū etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd6:11.2.2: imaṃ mayaṃ pariggahetvā uccāram pi passāvam pi nikkhāmemā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd6:11.2.3: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd6:11.2.5: kāḷañjanaṃ rasañjanaṃ sotañjanaṃ gerukaṃ kapallan ti.
pli-tv-kd6:11.2.8: anujānāmi bhikkhave candanaṃ tagaraṃ kāḷānusāriyaṃ tālīsaṃ bhaddamuttakan ti. ||2||11||
pli-tv-kd6:12.1.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū piṭṭhāni añjanāni thālikesu pi sarāvakesu pi nikkhipanti.
pli-tv-kd6:12.1.5: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū uccāvacā añjaniyo dhārenti
pli-tv-kd6:12.1.12: anujānāmi bhikkhave aṭṭhimayaṃ dantamayaṃ visāṇamayaṃ naḷamayaṃ veḷumayaṃ kaṭṭhamayaṃ jatumayaṃ phalamayaṃ lohamayaṃ saṅkhanābhimayan ti. ||1||
pli-tv-kd6:12.2.1: tena kho pana samayena añjanī apārutā honti. tiṇacuṇṇehi pi paṃsukehi pi okiriyanti
pli-tv-kd6:12.2.6: anujānāmi bhikkhave suttakena bandhitvā añjaniyā bandhitun ti.
pli-tv-kd6:12.3.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū aṅguliyā añjanti. akkhīni dukkhāni honti
pli-tv-kd6:12.3.4: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū uccāvacā añjanisalākāyo dhārenti
pli-tv-kd6:12.4.1: tena kho pana samayena añjanisalākā bhūmiyaṃ patitā pharusā hoti
pli-tv-kd6:12.4.4: tenakho pana samayena bhikkhū añjanim pi añjanisalākam pi hatthena pariharanti
pli-tv-kd6:13.1.1: tena kho pana samayena āyasmato Pilindavacchassa sīsābhitāpo hoti
pli-tv-kd6:13.1.10: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū uccāvacā natthukaraṇiyo dhārenti
pli-tv-kd6:13.2.7: tañ ñeva vaṭṭiṃ ālimpetvā pivanti. kaṇṭhaṃ dahati
pli-tv-kd6:13.2.10: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū uccāvacāni dhūmanettāni dhārenti . . .
pli-tv-kd6:13.2.18: tena kho pana samayena dhūmanettāni apārutāni honti, pāṇakā pavisanti
pli-tv-kd6:13.2.21: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū dhūmanettāni hatthena pariharanti.
pli-tv-kd6:14.1.1: tena kho pana samayena āyasmato Pilindavacchassa vātābādho hoti.
pli-tv-kd6:14.1.6: tasmiṃ kho pana telapāke majjaṃ pakkhipitabbaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-kd6:14.1.8: anujānāmi bhikkhave telapāke majjaṃ pakkhipitun ti.
pli-tv-kd6:14.1.9: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū atipakkhittamajjāni telāni pacanti. tāni pivitvā majjanti.
pli-tv-kd6:14.1.13: anujānāmi bhikkhave yasmiṃ telapāke majjassa na vaṇṇo na gandho na raso paññāyati, evarūpaṃ majjapakkhittaṃ telaṃ pātun ti. ||1||
pli-tv-kd6:14.2.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhūnaṃ bahuṃ atipakkhittamajjaṃ telaṃ pakkaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-kd6:14.2.2: atha kho bhikkhūnaṃ etad ahosi: kathaṃ nu kho atipakkhittamajje tele paṭipajjitabban ti.
pli-tv-kd6:14.2.5: tena kho pana samayena āyasmato Pilindavacchassa bahutaraṃ telaṃ pakkaṃ hoti, telabhājanaṃ na saṃvijjati.
pli-tv-kd6:14.3.1: tena kho pana samayena āyasmato Pilindavacchassa aṅgavāto hoti.
pli-tv-kd6:14.4.1: tena kho pana samayena āyasmato Pilindavacchassa pabbavāto hoti.
pli-tv-kd6:14.4.6: anujānāmi bhikkhave lohitaṃ mocetvā visāṇena gahetun ti.
pli-tv-kd6:14.4.7: tena kho pana samayena āyasmato Pilindavacchassa pādā phālitā honti.
pli-tv-kd6:14.4.13: tena kho pana samayena aññatarassa bhikkhuno gaṇḍābādho hoti.
pli-tv-kd6:14.5.21: anujānāmi bhikkhave vikāsikaṃ sabbaṃ vaṇapaṭikamman ti. ||5||
pli-tv-kd6:14.6.1: tena kho pana samayena aññataro bhikkhu ahinā daṭṭho hoti.
pli-tv-kd6:14.6.8: anujānāmi bhikkhave sati kappiyakārake paṭiggahāpetuṃ, asati kappiyakārake sāmaṃ gahetvā paribhuñjitun ti.
pli-tv-kd6:14.6.9: tena kho pana samayena aññatarena bhikkhunā visaṃ pītaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-kd6:14.6.15: anujānāmi bhikkhave yaṃ karonto paṭiggaṇhāti sv eva paṭiggaho kato, na puna paṭiggahāpetabbo 'ti. ||6||
pli-tv-kd6:14.7.1: tena kho pana samayena aññatarassa bhikkhuno gharadinnakābādho hoti.
pli-tv-kd6:14.7.4: tena kho pana samayena aññataro bhikkhu duṭṭhagahaṇiko hoti.
pli-tv-kd6:14.7.7: tena kho pana samayena aññatarassa bhikkhuno paṇḍurogābādho hoti.
pli-tv-kd6:14.7.10: tena kho pana samayena aññatarassa bhikkhuno chavidosābādho hoti.
pli-tv-kd6:14.7.13: tena kho pana samayena aññataro bhikkhu abhisannakāyo hoti.
pli-tv-kd6:15.1.1: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā Pilindavaccho Rājagahe pabbhāraṃ sodhāpeti leṇaṃ kattukāmo.
pli-tv-kd6:15.1.2: atha kho rājā Māgadho Seniyo Bimbisāro yenāyasmā Pilindavaccho ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Pilindavacchaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd6:15.1.3: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho rājā Māgadho Seniyo Bimbisāro āyasmantaṃ Pilindavacchaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd6:15.1.7: na kho mahārāja bhagavatā ārāmiko anuññāto 'ti.
pli-tv-kd6:15.1.8: tena hi bhante bhagavantaṃ paṭipucchitvā mama āroceyyāthā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd6:15.1.9: evaṃ mahārājā 'ti kho āyasmā Pilindavaccho rañño Māgadhassa Seniyassa Bimbisārassa paccassosi. ||1||
pli-tv-kd6:15.2.1: atha kho āyasmā Pilindavaccho rājānaṃ Māgadhaṃ Seniyaṃ Bimbisāraṃ dhammiyā kathāya sandassesi samādapesi samuttejesi sampahaṃsesi.
pli-tv-kd6:15.2.2: atha kho rājā Māgadho Seniyo Bimbisāro āyasmatā Pilindavacchena dhammiyā kathāya sandassito samādapito samuttejito sampahaṃsito uṭṭhāyāsanā āyasmantaṃ Pilindavacchaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
pli-tv-kd6:15.2.3: atha kho āyasmā Pilindavaccho bhagavato santike dūtaṃ pāhesi:
pli-tv-kd6:15.2.4: rājā bhante Māgadho Seniyo Bimbisāro ārāmikaṃ dātukāmo.
pli-tv-kd6:15.2.5: kathaṃ nu kho bhante paṭipajjitabban ti.
pli-tv-kd6:15.2.6: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd6:15.3.1: dutiyam pi kho rājā Māgadho Seniyo Bimbisāro yenāyasmā Pilindavaccho ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Pilindavacchaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd6:15.3.2: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho rājā Māgadho Seniyo Bimbisāro āyasmantaṃ Pilindavacchaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd6:15.3.5: tena hi bhante ayyassa ārāmikaṃ dammīti.
pli-tv-kd6:15.3.6: atha kho rājā Māgadho Seniyo Bimbisāro āyasmato Pilindavacchassa ārāmikaṃ paṭisuṇitvā vissaritvā cirena satiṃ paṭilabhitvā aññataraṃ sabbatthakaṃ mahāmattaṃ āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd6:15.3.7: yo mayā bhaṇe ayyassa ārāmiko paṭissuto dinno so ārāmiko 'ti.
pli-tv-kd6:15.3.8: na kho deva ayyassa ārāmiko dinno 'ti.
pli-tv-kd6:15.3.9: kīvaciraṃ nu kho bhaṇe ito hitaṃ hotīti. ||3||
pli-tv-kd6:15.4.1: atha kho so mahāmatto rattiyo vigaṇetvā rājānaṃ Māgadhaṃ Seniyaṃ Bimbisāraṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd6:15.4.3: tena hi bhaṇe ayyassa pañca ārāmikasatāni dethā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd6:15.4.5: kho so mahāmatto rañño Māgadhassa Seniyassa Bimbisārassa paṭisuṇitvā āyasmato Pilindavacchassa pañca ārāmikasatāni pādāsi, pāṭiyekko gāmo nivisi.
pli-tv-kd6:15.4.6: Ārāmikagāmo 'ti pi naṃ āhaṃsu, Pilindagāmo 'ti pi naṃ āhaṃsu.
pli-tv-kd6:15.4.7: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā Pilindavaccho tasmiṃ gāmake kulūpako hoti.
pli-tv-kd6:15.4.8: atha kho āyasmā Pilindavaccho pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya Pilindagāmaṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi. ||4||
pli-tv-kd6:15.5.1: tena kho pana samayena tasmiṃ gāmake ussavo hoti,
pli-tv-kd6:15.5.3: atha kho āyasmā Pilindavaccho Pilindagāmake sapadānaṃ piṇḍāya caramāno yena aññatarassa ārāmikassa nivesanaṃ ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd6:15.5.4: tena kho pana samayena tassā ārāmikiniyā dhītā aññe dārake alaṃkate mālākite passitvā rodati:
pli-tv-kd6:15.5.5: mālaṃ me detha, alaṃkāraṃ me dethā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd6:15.5.6: atha kho āyasmā Pilindavaccho taṃ ārāmikiniṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd6:15.5.8: ayaṃ bhante dārikā aññe dārake alaṃkate mālākite passitvā rodati:
pli-tv-kd6:15.5.9: mālaṃ me detha, alaṃkāraṃ me dethā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd6:15.5.10: kuto amhākaṃ duggatānaṃ mālā, kuto alaṃkāro 'ti. ||5||
pli-tv-kd6:15.6.1: atha kho āyasmā Pilindavaccho aññataraṃ tiṇaṇḍupakaṃ gahetvā taṃ ārāmikiniṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd6:15.6.2: hand' imaṃ tiṇaṇḍupakaṃ tassā dārikāya sīse paṭimuñcā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd6:15.6.3: atha kho sā ārāmikinī taṃ tiṇaṇḍupakaṃ gahetvā tassā dārikāya sīse paṭimuñci.
pli-tv-kd6:15.6.4: sā ahosi suvaṇṇamālā abhirūpā dassanīyā pāsādikā,
pli-tv-kd6:15.6.5: n' atthi tādisā rañño pi antepure suvaṇṇamālā.
pli-tv-kd6:15.6.6: manussā rañño Māgadhassa Seniyassa Bimbisārassa ārocesuṃ:
pli-tv-kd6:15.6.7: amukassa deva ārāmikassa ghare suvaṇṇamālā abhirūpā dassanīyā pāsādikā,
pli-tv-kd6:15.6.8: n' atthi tādisā devassa pi antepure suvaṇṇamālā.
pli-tv-kd6:15.6.11: atha kho rājā Māgadho Seniyo Bimbisāro taṃ ārāmikakulaṃ bandhāpesi. ||6||
pli-tv-kd6:15.7.1: dutiyam pi kho āyasmā Pilindavaccho pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaram ādāya Pilindagāmaṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi.
pli-tv-kd6:15.7.2: Pilindagāmake sapadānaṃ piṇḍāya caramāno yena tassa ārāmikassa nivesanaṃ ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā paṭivissake pucchi:
pli-tv-kd6:15.7.4: etissā bhante suvaṇṇamālāya kāraṇā raññā bandhāpitan ti.
pli-tv-kd6:15.7.5: atha kho āyasmā Pilindavaccho yena rañño Māgadhassa Seniyassa Bimbisārassa nivesanaṃ ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd6:15.7.6: atha kho rājā Māgadho Seniyo Bimbisāro yenāyasmā Pilindavaccho ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Pilindavacchaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd6:15.7.7: ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho rājānaṃ Māgadhaṃ Seniyaṃ Bimbisāraṃ āyasmā Pilindavaccho etad avoca: ||7||
pli-tv-kd6:15.8.2: tassa bhante ārāmikassa ghare suvaṇṇamālā abhirūpā dassanīyā pāsādikā,
pli-tv-kd6:15.8.3: n' atthi tādisā amhākam pi antepure suvaṇṇamālā.
pli-tv-kd6:15.8.6: atha kho āyasmā Pilindavaccho rañño Māgadhassa Seniyassa Bimbisārassa pāsādaṃ suvaṇṇan ti adhimucci,
pli-tv-kd6:15.8.8: idaṃ pana te mahārāja tāvabahuṃ suvaṇṇaṃ kuto 'ti.
pli-tv-kd6:15.8.9: aññātaṃ bhante, ayyassa eso iddhānubhāvo 'ti taṃ ārāmikakulaṃ muñcāpesi. ||8||
pli-tv-kd6:15.9.2: ayyena kira Pilindavacchena sarājikāya parisāya uttarimanussadhammaṃ iddhipāṭihāriyaṃ dassitan ti
pli-tv-kd6:15.9.3: attamanā abhippasannā āyasmato Pilindavacchassa pañca bhesajjāni abhihariṃsu seyyath' īdaṃ:
pli-tv-kd6:15.9.4: sappiṃ navanītaṃ telaṃ madhuṃ phāṇitan ti.
pli-tv-kd6:15.9.5: pakatiyāpi ca āyasmā Pilindavaccho lābhī hoti, pañcannaṃ bhesajjānaṃ
pli-tv-kd6:15.9.8: laddhaṃ -laddhaṃ kolambe pi ghaṭe pi pūretvā paṭisāmeti,
pli-tv-kd6:15.9.9: parissāvanāni pi thavikāyo pi pūretvā vātapānesu lagganti,
pli-tv-kd6:15.9.12: manussā vihāracārikaṃ āhiṇḍantā passitvā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-kd6:15.9.13: antokoṭṭhāgārikā ime samaṇā Sakyaputtiyā seyyathāpi rājā Māgadho Seniyo Bimbisāro 'ti. ||9||
pli-tv-kd6:15.10.1: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tesaṃ manussānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khīyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-kd6:15.10.2: ye te bhikkhū appicchā te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-kd6:15.10.3: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhū evarūpāya bāhullāya cetessantīti.
pli-tv-kd6:15.10.4: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd6:15.10.5: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave bhikkhū evarūpāya bāhullāya cetentīti.
pli-tv-kd6:15.10.7: vigarahitvā dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd6:15.10.8: yāni kho pana tāni gilānānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ paṭisāyaniyāni bhesajjāni seyyath' īdaṃ: sappi navanītaṃ telaṃ madhu phāṇitaṃ, tāni paṭiggahetvā sattāhaparamaṃ sannidhikārakaṃ paribhuñjitabbāni, taṃ atikkāmayato yathādhammo kāretabbo 'ti. ||10||15||
pli-tv-kd6:16.1.1: atha kho bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ yathābhirantaṃ viharitvā yena Rājagahaṃ tena cārikaṃ pakkāmi.
pli-tv-kd6:16.1.2: addasa kho āyasmā Kaṅkhārevato antarā magge guḷakaraṇaṃ okkamitvā guḷe piṭṭham pi chārikam pi pakkhipante, disvāna
pli-tv-kd6:16.1.3: akappiyo guḷo sāmiso, na kappati guḷo vikāle paribhuñjitun ti
pli-tv-kd6:16.1.5: ye pi 'ssa sotabbaṃ maññanti, te pi guḷaṃ na paribhuñjanti.
pli-tv-kd6:16.1.7: kimatthiyā bhikkhave guḷe piṭṭham pi chārikam pi pakkhipantīti.
pli-tv-kd6:16.1.9: sace bhikkhave thaddhanatthāya guḷe piṭṭham pi chārikam pi pakkhipanti so ca guḷo tv eva saṃkhaṃ gacchati,
pli-tv-kd6:16.1.10: anujānāmi bhikkhave yathāsukhaṃ guḷaṃ paribhuñjitun ti. ||1||
pli-tv-kd6:16.2.1: addasa kho āyasmā Kaṅkhārevato antarā magge vacce muggaṃ jātaṃ, passitvā
pli-tv-kd6:16.2.5: ye pi 'ssa sotabbaṃ maññanti, te pi muggaṃ na paribhuñjanti.
pli-tv-kd6:16.2.7: sace bhikkhave pakkāpi muggā jāyanti, anujānāmi bhikkhave yathāsukhaṃ muggaṃ paribhuñjitun ti. ||2||
pli-tv-kd6:16.3.1: tena kho pana samayena aññatarassa bhikkhuno udaravātābādho hoti,
pli-tv-kd6:17.1.1: atha kho bhagavā anupubbena cārikaṃ caramāno yena Rājagahaṃ tad avasari. tatra sudaṃ bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Veḷuvane Kalandakanivāpe.
pli-tv-kd6:17.1.2: tena kho pana samayena bhagavato udaravātābādho hoti.
pli-tv-kd6:17.1.3: atha kho āyasmā Ānando pubbe pi bhagavato udaravātābādho tekaṭulāya yāguyā phāsu hotīti
pli-tv-kd6:17.1.4: sāmaṃ tilam pi taṇḍulam pi muggam pi paññāpetvā anto vāsetvā anto sāmaṃ pacitvā bhagavato upanāmesi
pli-tv-kd6:17.2.1: jānantāpi tathāgatā pucchanti, jānantāpi na pucchanti,
pli-tv-kd6:17.2.2: kālaṃ viditvā pucchanti, kālaṃ viditvā na pucchanti,
pli-tv-kd6:17.2.5: dvīhi ākārehi buddhā bhagavanto bhikkhū paṭipucchanti, dhammaṃ vā desessāma, sāvakānaṃ vā sikkhāpadaṃ paññāpessāmā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd6:17.2.6: atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ Ānandaṃ āmantesi: kut' āyaṃ Ānanda yāgū 'ti.
pli-tv-kd6:17.2.7: atha kho āyasmā Ānando bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesi. ||2||
pli-tv-kd6:17.3.2: ananucchaviyaṃ Ānanda ananulomikaṃ appaṭirūpaṃ assāmaṇakaṃ akappiyaṃ akaraṇīyaṃ.
pli-tv-kd6:17.3.3: kathaṃ hi nāma tvaṃ Ānanda evarūpāya bāhullāya cetessasi.
pli-tv-kd6:17.3.4: yad api Ānanda anto vutthaṃ tad api akappiyaṃ,
pli-tv-kd6:17.3.5: yad api anto pakkaṃ tad api akappiyaṃ,
pli-tv-kd6:17.3.6: yad api sāmaṃ pakkaṃ tad api akappiyaṃ.
pli-tv-kd6:17.3.7: n' etaṃ Ānanda appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya.
pli-tv-kd6:17.3.8: vigarahitvā dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd6:17.3.9: na bhikkhave anto vutthaṃ anto pakkaṃ sāmaṃ pakkaṃ paribhuñjitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd6:17.4.1: anto ce bhikkhave vutthaṃ anto pakkaṃ sāmaṃ pakkaṃ, tañ ce paribhuñjeyya, āpatti tiṇṇaṃ dukkaṭānaṃ.
pli-tv-kd6:17.4.2: anto ce bhikkhave vutthaṃ anto pakkaṃ aññehi pakkaṃ, tañ ce paribhuñjeyya, āpatti dvinnaṃ dukkaṭānaṃ.
pli-tv-kd6:17.4.3: anto ce bhikkhave vutthaṃ bahi pakkaṃ sāmaṃ pakkaṃ, tañ ce paribhuñjeyya, āpatti dvinnaṃ dukkaṭānaṃ. ||4||
pli-tv-kd6:17.5.1: bahi ce bhikkhave vutthaṃ anto pakkaṃ sāmaṃ pakkaṃ, tañ ce paribhuñjeyya, āpatti dvinnaṃ dukkaṭānaṃ.
pli-tv-kd6:17.5.2: anto ce bhikkhave vutthaṃ bahi pakkaṃ aññehi pakkaṃ, tañ ce paribhuñjeyya, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-kd6:17.5.3: bahi ce bhikkhave vutthaṃ anto pakkaṃ aññehi pakkaṃ, tañ ce paribhuñjeyya, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-kd6:17.5.4: bahi ce bhikkhave vutthaṃ bahi pakkaṃ sāmaṃ pakkaṃ, tañ ce paribhuñjeyya, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-kd6:17.5.5: bahi ce bhikkhave vutthaṃ bahi pakkaṃ aññehi pakkaṃ, tañ ce paribhuñjeyya, anāpattīti. ||5||
pli-tv-kd6:17.7.1: tena kho pana samayena Rājagahaṃ dubbhikkhaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-kd6:17.7.2: manussā loṇam pi telam pi taṇḍulam pi khādaniyam pi ārāmaṃ āharanti,
pli-tv-kd6:17.7.12: dubbhikkhe kappiyakārakā bahutaraṃ haranti, appataraṃ bhikkhūnaṃ denti.
pli-tv-kd6:17.7.15: anujānāmi bhikkhave anto vutthaṃ anto pakkaṃ sāmaṃ pakkan ti. ||7||
pli-tv-kd6:17.8.1: tena kho pana samayena sambahulā bhikkhū Kāsīsu vassaṃ vutthā Rājagahaṃ gacchantā bhagavantaṃ dassanāya antarā magge na labhiṃsu lūkhassa vā paṇītassa vā bhojanassa yāvadatthaṃ pāripūriṃ,
pli-tv-kd6:17.8.4: atha kho te bhikkhū kilantarūpā yena Rājagahaṃ Veḷuvanaṃ Kalandakanivāpo yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkamiṃsu, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu.
pli-tv-kd6:17.8.5: āciṇṇaṃ kho pan' etaṃ buddhānaṃ bhagavantānaṃ āgantukehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ paṭisammodituṃ.
pli-tv-kd6:17.8.6: atha kho bhagavā te bhikkhū etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd6:17.9.2: idha mayaṃ bhante Kāsīsu vassaṃ vutthā Rājagahaṃ āgacchantā bhagavantaṃ dassanāya antarā magge na labhimhā lūkhassa vā paṇītassa vā bhojanassa yāvadatthaṃ pāripūriṃ,
pli-tv-kd6:17.9.6: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd6:17.9.7: anujānāmi bhikkhave yattha phalakhādaniyaṃ passati kappiyakārako ca na hoti, sāmaṃ gahetvā haritvā kappiyakārakaṃ passitvā bhūmiyaṃ nikkhipitvā paṭiggahāpetvā paribhuñjituṃ.
pli-tv-kd6:18.1.1: tena kho pana samayena aññatarassa brāhmaṇassa navā ca tilā navañ ca madhuṃ uppannā honti.
pli-tv-kd6:18.1.2: atha kho tassa brāhmaṇassa etad ahosi: yaṃ
pli-tv-kd6:18.1.3: nūnāhaṃ nave ca tile navañ ca madhuṃ buddhapamukhassa bhikkhusaṃghassa dadeyyan ti.
pli-tv-kd6:18.1.4: atha kho so brāhmaṇo yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi. sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sāraṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi,
pli-tv-kd6:18.1.5: ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho so brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd6:18.1.6: adhivāsetu me bhante bhavaṃ Gotamo svātanāya bhattaṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṃghenā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd6:18.1.8: atha kho so brāhmaṇo bhagavato adhivāsanaṃ viditvā pakkāmi. ||1||
pli-tv-kd6:18.2.1: atha kho so brāhmaṇo tassā rattiyā accayena paṇītam khādaniyaṃ bhojaniyaṃ paṭiyādāpetvā bhagavato kālaṃ ārocāpesi:
pli-tv-kd6:18.2.2: kālo bho Gotama, niṭṭhitaṃ bhattan ti.
pli-tv-kd6:18.2.3: atha kho bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya yena tassa brāhmaṇassa nivesanaṃ ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṃghena.
pli-tv-kd6:18.2.4: atha kho so brāhmaṇo buddhapamukhaṃ bhikkhusaṃghaṃ paṇītena khādaniyena bhojaniyena sahatthā santappetvā sampavāretvā bhagavantaṃ bhuttāviṃ onītapattapāṇiṃ ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd6:18.2.5: ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho taṃ brāhmaṇaṃ bhagavā dhammiyā kathāya sandassetvā samādapetvā samuttejetvā sampahaṃsetvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmi. ||2||
pli-tv-kd6:18.3.1: atha kho tassa brāhmaṇassa acirapakkantassa bhagavato etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd6:18.3.2: yesaṃ kho mayā atthāya buddhapamukho bhikkhusaṃgho nimantito nave ca tile navañ ca madhuṃ dassāmīti, te mayā pamuṭṭhā dātuṃ.
pli-tv-kd6:18.3.3: yaṃ nūnāhaṃ nave ca tile navañ ca madhuṃ kolambehi ca ghaṭehi ca ārāmaṃ harāpeyyan ti.
pli-tv-kd6:18.3.4: atha kho so brāhmaṇo nave ca tile navañ ca madhuṃ kolambehi ca ghaṭehi ca ārāmaṃ āharāpetvā yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi,
pli-tv-kd6:18.3.5: ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho so brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etad avoca: ||3||
pli-tv-kd6:18.4.1: yesaṃ kho mayā bho Gotama atthāya buddhapamukho bhikkhusaṃgho nimantito nave ca tile navañ ca madhuṃ dassāmīti, te mayā pamuṭṭhā dātuṃ.
pli-tv-kd6:18.4.2: paṭigaṇhātu me bhavaṃ Gotamo nave ca tile navañ ca madhun ti.
pli-tv-kd6:18.4.4: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū dubbhikkhe appamattake pi pavārenti paṭisaṃkhāpi paṭikkhipanti,
pli-tv-kd6:18.4.5: sabbo ca saṃgho pavārito hoti, bhikkhū kukkuccāyantā na paṭigaṇhanti.
pli-tv-kd6:18.4.7: anujānāmi bhikkhave tato nīhataṃ bhuttāvinā pavāritena anatirittaṃ paribhuñjitun ti. ||4||18||
pli-tv-kd6:19.1.1: tena kho pana samayena āyasmato Upanandassa Sakyaputtassa upaṭṭhākakulaṃ saṃghass' atthāya khādaniyaṃ pāhesi:
pli-tv-kd6:19.1.2: ayyassa Upanandassa dassetvā saṃghassa dātabban ti.
pli-tv-kd6:19.1.3: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā Upanando Sakyaputto gāmaṃ piṇḍāya paviṭṭho hoti.
pli-tv-kd6:19.1.4: atha kho te manussā ārāmaṃ gantvā bhikkhū pucchiṃsu:
pli-tv-kd6:19.1.6: esāvuso āyasmā Upanando Sakyaputto gāmaṃ piṇḍāya paviṭṭho 'ti.
pli-tv-kd6:19.1.7: idaṃ bhante khādaniyaṃ ayyassa Upanandassa dassetvā saṃghassa dātabban ti.
pli-tv-kd6:19.1.9: tena hi bhikkhave paṭiggahetvā nikkhipatha yāva Upanando āgacchatīti. ||1||
pli-tv-kd6:19.2.1: atha kho āyasmā Upanando Sakyaputto purebhattaṃ kulāni payirupāsitvā divā āgacchi.
pli-tv-kd6:19.2.2: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū dubbhikkhe appamattake pi pavārenti paṭisaṃkhāpi paṭikkhipanti, sabbo ca saṃgho pavārito hoti,
pli-tv-kd6:19.2.5: anujānāmi bhikkhave purebhattaṃ paṭiggahitaṃ bhuttāvinā pavāritena anatirittaṃ paribhuñjitun ti. ||2||19||
pli-tv-kd6:20.1.1: atha kho bhagavā Rājagahe yathābhirantaṃ viharitvā yena Sāvatthi tena cārikaṃ pakkāmi.
pli-tv-kd6:20.1.2: anupubbena cārikaṃ caramāno yena Sāvatthi tad avasari.
pli-tv-kd6:20.1.3: tatra sudaṃ bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-kd6:20.1.4: tena kho pana samayena āyasmato Sāriputtassa kāyaḍāhābādho hoti.
pli-tv-kd6:20.1.5: atha kho āyasmā Mahāmoggallāno yenāyasmā Sāriputto ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Sāriputtaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd6:20.1.6: pubbe te āvuso Sāriputta kāyaḍāhābādho kena phāsu hotīti.
pli-tv-kd6:20.1.7: bhisehi ca me āvuso muḷālikāhi cā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd6:20.1.8: atha kho āyasmā Mahāmoggallāno seyyathāpi nāma balavā puriso sammiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ sammiñjeyya, evam eva Jetavane antarahito Mandākiniyā pokkharaṇiyā tīre pāturahosi. ||1||
pli-tv-kd6:20.2.1: addasa kho aññataro nāgo āyasmantaṃ Mahāmoggallānaṃ dūrato 'va āgacchantaṃ, disvāna āyasmantaṃ Mahāmoggallānaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd6:20.2.2: etu kho bhante ayyo Mahāmoggallāno, svāgataṃ bhante ayyassa Mahāmoggallānassa,
pli-tv-kd6:20.2.5: bhisehi ca me āvuso attho muḷālikāhi cā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd6:20.2.6: atha kho so nāgo aññataraṃ nāgaṃ āṇāpesi:
pli-tv-kd6:20.2.7: tena hi bhaṇe ayyassa bhise ca muḷālikāyo ca yāvadatthaṃ dehīti.
pli-tv-kd6:20.2.8: atha kho so nāgo Mandākiniṃ pokkharaṇiṃ ogāhetvā soṇḍāya bhisañ ca muḷāliñ ca abbāhitvā suvikkhālitaṃ vikkhāletvā bhaṇḍikaṃ bandhitvā yenāyasmā Mahāmoggallāno ten' upasaṃkami. ||2||
pli-tv-kd6:20.3.1: atha kho āyasmā Mahāmoggallāno seyyathāpi nāma balavā puriso sammiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ sammiñjeyya, evam eva Mandākiniyā pokkharaṇiyā tīre antarahito Jetavane pāturahosi,
pli-tv-kd6:20.3.2: so pi kho nāgo Mandākiniyā pokkharaṇiyā tīre antarahito Jetavane pāturahosi.
pli-tv-kd6:20.3.3: atha kho so nāgo āyasmato Mahāmoggallānassa bhise ca muḷālikāyo ca paṭiggahāpetvā Jetavane antarahito Mandākiniyā pokkharaṇiyā tīre pāturahosi.
pli-tv-kd6:20.3.4: atha kho āyasmā Mahāmoggallāno āyasmato Sāriputtassa bhise ca muḷālikāyo ca upanāmesi.
pli-tv-kd6:20.3.5: atha kho āyasmato Sāriputtassa bhise ca muḷālikāyo ca paribhuttassa kāyaḍāhābādho paṭippassambhi.
pli-tv-kd6:20.3.6: bahū bhisā ca muḷālikāyo ca avasiṭṭhā honti. ||3||
pli-tv-kd6:20.4.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū dubbhikkhe appamattake pi pavārenti paṭisaṃkhāpi paṭikkhipanti, sabbo ca saṃgho pavārito hoti,
pli-tv-kd6:20.4.4: anujānāmi bhikkhave vanaṭṭhaṃ pokkharaṭṭhaṃ bhuttāvinā pavāritena anatirittaṃ paribhuñjitun ti. ||4||20||
pli-tv-kd6:21.1.1: tena kho pana samayena Sāvatthiyaṃ bahuṃ phalakhādaniyaṃ ussannaṃ hoti kappiyakārako ca na hoti.
pli-tv-kd6:21.1.4: anujānāmi bhikkhave abījaṃ nibbattabījaṃ akatakappaṃ phalaṃ paribhuñjitun ti. ||1||21||
pli-tv-kd6:22.1.1: atha kho bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ yathābhirantaṃ viharitvā yena Rājagahaṃ tena cārikaṃ pakkāmi.
pli-tv-kd6:22.1.2: anupubbena cārikaṃ caramāno yena Rājagahaṃ tad avasari.
pli-tv-kd6:22.1.3: tatra sudaṃ bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Veḷuvane Kalandakanivāpe.
pli-tv-kd6:22.1.4: tena kho pana samayena aññatarassa bhikkhuno bhagandalābādho hoti.
pli-tv-kd6:22.1.6: atha kho bhagavā senāsanacārikaṃ āhiṇḍanto yena tassa bhikkhuno vihāro ten' upasaṃkami. ||1||
pli-tv-kd6:22.2.1: addasa kho Ākāsagotto vejjo bhagavantaṃ dūrato 'va āgacchantaṃ, disvāna bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd6:22.2.2: āgacchatu bhavaṃ Gotamo imassa bhikkhuno vaccamaggaṃ passatu seyyathāpi godhāmukhan ti.
pli-tv-kd6:22.2.5: tuṇhibhūto 'va paṭinivattitvā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe bhikkhusaṃghaṃ sannipātāpetvā bhikkhū paṭipucchi:
pli-tv-kd6:22.2.6: atthi kira bhikkhave amukasmiṃ vihāre bhikkhu gilāno 'ti.
pli-tv-kd6:22.2.9: tassa bhante āyasmato bhagandalābādho, Ākāsagotto vejjo satthakammaṃ karotīti. ||2||
pli-tv-kd6:22.3.2: ananucchaviyaṃ bhikkhave tassa moghapurisassa ananulomikaṃ appaṭirūpaṃ assāmaṇakaṃ akappiyaṃ akaraṇīyaṃ.
pli-tv-kd6:22.3.3: kathaṃ hi nāma so bhikkhave moghapuriso sambādhe satthakammaṃ kārāpessatīti.
pli-tv-kd6:22.3.4: sambādhe bhikkhave sukhumā chavi, duropayo vaṇo, dupparihāraṃ satthaṃ.
pli-tv-kd6:22.3.5: n' etaṃ bhikkhave appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya.
pli-tv-kd6:22.4.1: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū
pli-tv-kd6:22.4.4: ye te bhikkhū appicchā te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-kd6:22.4.5: kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū vatthikammaṃ kārāpessantīti.
pli-tv-kd6:22.4.6: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd6:22.4.7: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave chabbaggiyā bhikkhū vatthikammaṃ kārāpentīti.
pli-tv-kd6:22.4.9: vigarahitvā dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd6:22.4.10: na bhikkhave sambādhassa sāmantā dvaṅgulā satthakammaṃ vā vatthikammaṃ vā kārāpetabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd6:23.1.1: atha kho bhagavā Rājagahe yathābhirantaṃ viharitvā yena Bārāṇasī tena cārikaṃ pakkāmi.
pli-tv-kd6:23.1.2: anupubbena cārikaṃ caramāno yena Bārāṇasī tad avasari.
pli-tv-kd6:23.1.3: tatra sudaṃ bhagavā Bārāṇasiyaṃ viharati Isipatane migadāye.
pli-tv-kd6:23.1.4: tena kho pana samayena Bārāṇasiyaṃ Suppiyo ca upāsako Suppiyā ca upāsikā ubhatopasannā honti dāyakā kārakā saṃghupaṭṭhākā.
pli-tv-kd6:23.1.5: atha kho Suppiyā upāsikā ārāmaṃ gantvā vihārena vihāraṃ pariveṇena pariveṇaṃ upasaṃkamitvā bhikkhū pucchati:
pli-tv-kd6:23.1.6: ko bhante gilāno, kassa kiṃ āhariyyatū 'ti. ||1||
pli-tv-kd6:23.2.1: tena kho pana samayena aññatarena bhikkhunā virecanaṃ pītaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-kd6:23.2.2: atha kho so bhikkhu Suppiyaṃ upāsikaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd6:23.2.8: evaṃ ayye 'ti kho so puriso Suppiyāya upāsikāya paṭisuṇitvā kevalakappaṃ Bārāṇasiṃ āhiṇḍanto na addasa pavattamaṃsaṃ.
pli-tv-kd6:23.2.9: atha kho so puriso yena Suppiyā upāsikā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā Suppiyaṃ upāsikaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd6:23.3.1: atha kho Suppiyāya upāsikāya etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd6:23.3.2: tassa kho gilānassa bhikkhuno paṭicchādaniyaṃ alabhantassa ābādho vā abhivaḍḍhissati kālaṃkiriyā vā bhavissati,
pli-tv-kd6:23.3.3: na kho me taṃ paṭirūpaṃ yāhaṃ paṭisuṇitvā na harāpeyyan ti
pli-tv-kd6:23.3.4: potthanikaṃ gahetvā ūrumaṃsaṃ ukkantitvā dāsiyā adāsi:
pli-tv-kd6:23.3.5: handa je imaṃ maṃsaṃ sampādetvā amukasmiṃ vihāre bhikkhu gilāno tassa dajjehi,
pli-tv-kd6:23.3.6: yo ca maṃ pucchati gilānā 'ti paṭivedehīti uttarāsaṅgena ūruṃ veṭhetvā ovarakaṃ pavisitvā mañcake nipajji. ||3||
pli-tv-kd6:23.4.1: atha kho Suppiyo upāsako gharaṃ gantvā dāsiṃ pucchi:
pli-tv-kd6:23.4.4: atha kho Suppiyo upāsako yena Suppiyā upāsikā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā Suppiyaṃ upāsikaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd6:23.4.8: atha kho Suppiyā upāsikā Suppiyassa upāsakassa etam atthaṃ ārocesi.
pli-tv-kd6:23.4.10: acchariyaṃ vata bho abbhutaṃ vata bho
pli-tv-kd6:23.4.11: yāva saddhāyaṃ Suppiyā pasannā, yatra hi nāma attano pi maṃsāni pariccattāni,
pli-tv-kd6:23.4.12: kim pana imāya aññaṃ kiñci adeyyaṃ bhavissatīti
pli-tv-kd6:23.4.13: haṭṭho udaggo yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ||4||
pli-tv-kd6:23.5.1: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho Suppiyo upāsako bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd6:23.5.2: adhivāsetu me bhante bhagavā svātanāya bhattaṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṃghenā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd6:23.5.4: atha kho Suppiyo upāsako bhagavato adhivāsanaṃ viditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
pli-tv-kd6:23.5.5: atha kho Suppiyo upāsako tassā rattiyā accayena paṇītaṃ khādaniyaṃ bhojaniyaṃ paṭiyādāpetvā bhagavato kālaṃ ārocāpesi: kālo bhante niṭṭhitaṃ bhattan ti.
pli-tv-kd6:23.5.6: atha kho bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya yena Suppiyassa upāsakassa nivesanaṃ ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṃghena. ||5||
pli-tv-kd6:23.6.1: atha kho Suppiyo upāsako yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi.
pli-tv-kd6:23.6.2: ekamantaṃ ṭhitaṃ kho Suppiyaṃ upāsakaṃ bhagavā etad avoca: kahaṃ Suppiyā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd6:23.6.7: atha kho Suppiyo upāsako Suppiyaṃ upāsikaṃ pariggahetvā ānesi.
pli-tv-kd6:23.6.8: tassā saha dassanena bhagavato tāvamahā vaṇo rūḷho ahosi succhavi lomajāto. ||6||
pli-tv-kd6:23.7.1: atha kho Suppiyo ca upāsako Suppiyā ca upāsikā
pli-tv-kd6:23.7.2: acchariyaṃ vata bho abbhutaṃ vata bho
pli-tv-kd6:23.7.3: tathāgatassa mahiddhikatā mahānubhāvatā, yatra hi nāma saha dassanena bhagavato tāvamahā vaṇo rūḷho bhavissati succhavi lomajāto 'ti
pli-tv-kd6:23.7.4: haṭṭhā udaggā buddhapamukhaṃ bhikkhusaṃghaṃ paṇītena khādaniyena bhojaniyena sahatthā santappetvā sampavāretvā bhagavantaṃ bhuttāviṃ onītapattapāṇiṃ ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu.
pli-tv-kd6:23.7.5: atha kho bhagavā Suppiyaṃ upāsakaṃ Suppiyañ ca upāsikaṃ dhammiyā kathāya sandassetvā samādapetvā samuttejetvā sampahaṃsetvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmi. ||7||
pli-tv-kd6:23.8.1: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe bhikkhusaṃghaṃ sannipātāpetvā bhikkhū paṭipucchi:
pli-tv-kd6:23.8.2: ko bhikkhave Suppiyaṃ upāsikaṃ maṃsaṃ viññāpesīti.
pli-tv-kd6:23.8.3: evaṃ vutte so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etad avoca: ahaṃ kho bhante Suppiyaṃ upāsikaṃ maṃsaṃ viññāpesin ti.
pli-tv-kd6:23.9.2: hi nāma tvaṃ moghapurisa appaṭivekkhitvā maṃsaṃ paribhuñjissasi.
pli-tv-kd6:23.9.4: n' etaṃ moghapurisa appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya.
pli-tv-kd6:23.9.5: vigarahitvā dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd6:23.9.6: santi bhikkhave manussā saddhā pasannā, tehi attano pi maṃsāni pariccattāni.
pli-tv-kd6:23.9.9: na ca bhikkhave appaṭivekkhitvā maṃsaṃ paribhuñjitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd6:23.10.1: tena kho pana samayena rañño hatthī maranti.
pli-tv-kd6:23.10.2: manussā dubbhikkhe hatthimaṃsaṃ paribhuñjanti, bhikkhūnaṃ piṇḍāya carantānaṃ hatthimaṃsaṃ denti,
pli-tv-kd6:23.10.5: kathaṃ hi nāma samaṇā Sakyaputtiyā hatthimaṃsaṃ paribhuñjissanti.
pli-tv-kd6:23.10.6: rājaṅgaṃ hatthī, sace rājā jāneyya, na nesaṃ attamano assā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd6:23.11.1: tena kho pana samayena rañño assā maranti.
pli-tv-kd6:23.11.2: manussā dubbhikkhe assamaṃsaṃ paribhuñjanti, bhikkhūnaṃ piṇḍāya carantānaṃ assamaṃsaṃ denti,
pli-tv-kd6:23.11.5: kathaṃ hi nāma samaṇā Sakyaputtiyā assamaṃsaṃ paribhuñjissanti.
pli-tv-kd6:23.11.6: rājaṅgaṃ assā, sace rājā jāneyya, na nesaṃ attamano assā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd6:23.12.1: tena kho pana samayena manussā dubbhikkhe sunakhamaṃsaṃ paribhuñjanti, bhikkhūnaṃ piṇḍāya carantānaṃ sunakhamaṃsaṃ denti,
pli-tv-kd6:23.12.4: kathaṃ hi nāma samaṇā Sakyaputtiyā sunakhamaṃsaṃ paribhuñjissanti, jeguccho sunakho paṭikkūlo 'ti.
pli-tv-kd6:23.13.1: tena kho pana samayena manussā dubbhikkhe ahimaṃsaṃ paribhuñjanti, bhikkhūnaṃ piṇḍāya carantānaṃ ahimaṃsaṃ denti,
pli-tv-kd6:23.13.4: kathaṃ hi nāma samaṇā Sakyaputtiyā ahimaṃsaṃ paribhuñjissanti, jeguccho ahi paṭikkūlo 'ti.
pli-tv-kd6:23.13.5: Supasso pi nāgarājā yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi.
pli-tv-kd6:23.13.6: ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho Supasso nāgarājā bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd6:23.13.9: sādhu bhante ayyā ahimaṃsaṃ na paribhuñjeyyun ti.
pli-tv-kd6:23.13.10: atha kho bhagavā Supassaṃ nāgarājānaṃ dhammiyā kathāya sandassesi --la-- padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
pli-tv-kd6:23.13.11: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd6:23.14.1: tena kho pana samayena luddakā sīhaṃ hantvā maṃsaṃ paribhuñjanti, bhikkhūnaṃ piṇḍāya carantānaṃ sīhamaṃsaṃ denti.
pli-tv-kd6:23.15.1: tena kho pana samayena luddakā vyagghaṃ hantvā,
pli-tv-kd6:23.15.4: taracchaṃ hantvā maṃsaṃ paribhuñjanti, bhikkhūnaṃ piṇḍāya carantānaṃ taracchamaṃsaṃ denti.
pli-tv-kd6:24.1.1: atha kho bhagavā Bārāṇasiyaṃ yathābhirantaṃ viharitvā yena Andhakavindaṃ tena cārikaṃ pakkāmi mahatā bhikkhusaṃghena saddhiṃ aḍḍhatelasehi bhikkhusatehi.
pli-tv-kd6:24.1.2: tena kho pana samayena jānapadā manussā bahuṃ loṇam pi telam pi taṇḍulam pi khadaniyam pi sakaṭesu āropetvā buddhapamukhassa bhikkhusaṃghassa piṭṭhito-piṭṭhito anubaddhā honti
pli-tv-kd6:24.1.3: yadā paṭipāṭiṃ labhissāma tadā bhattaṃ karissāmā 'ti, pañcamattāni ca vighāsādasatāni.
pli-tv-kd6:24.1.4: atha kho bhagavā anupubbena cārikaṃ caramāno yena Andhakavindaṃ tad avasari. ||1||
pli-tv-kd6:24.2.1: atha kho aññatarassa brāhmaṇassa paṭipāṭiṃ alabhantassa etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd6:24.2.2: atītāni kho me dve māsāni buddhapamukhaṃ bhikkhusaṃghaṃ anubaddhassa yadā paṭipāṭiṃ labhissāmi tadā bhattaṃ karissāmīti, na ca me paṭipāṭi labbhati, ahañ c' amhi ekako, bahu ca me gharāvāsattho hāyati.
pli-tv-kd6:24.2.4: yaṃ bhattagge na addasaṃ taṃ paṭiyādeyyan ti.
pli-tv-kd6:24.2.5: atha kho so brāhmaṇo bhattaggaṃ olokento dve nāddasa
pli-tv-kd6:24.3.1: atha kho so brāhmaṇo yenāyasmā Ānando ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Ānandaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd6:24.3.2: idha me bho Ānanda paṭipāṭiṃ alabhantassa etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd6:24.3.3: atītāni kho me dve māsāni buddhapamukhaṃ bhikkhusaṃghaṃ anubaddhassa yadā paṭipāṭiṃ labhissāmi tadā bhattaṃ karissāmīti,
pli-tv-kd6:24.3.4: na ca me paṭipāṭi labbhati, ahañ c' amhi ekako, bahu ca me gharāvāsattho hāyati.
pli-tv-kd6:24.3.6: yaṃ bhattagge na addasaṃ taṃ paṭiyādeyyan ti.
pli-tv-kd6:24.3.7: so kho ahaṃ bho Ānanda bhattaggaṃ olokento dve na addasaṃ
pli-tv-kd6:24.3.9: sac' āhaṃ bho Ānanda paṭiyādeyyaṃ yāguñ ca madhugoḷakañ ca, paṭigaṇheyya me bhavaṃ Gotamo 'ti.
pli-tv-kd6:24.4.1: atha kho āyasmā Ānando bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesi.
pli-tv-kd6:24.4.4: atha kho so brāhmaṇo tassā rattiyā accayena pahūtaṃ yāguñ ca madhugoḷakañ ca paṭiyādāpetvā bhagavato upanāmesi:
pli-tv-kd6:24.4.5: paṭigaṇhātu me bhavaṃ Gotamo yāguñ ca madhugoḷakañ cā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd6:24.4.9: atha kho so brāhmaṇo buddhapamukhaṃ bhikkhusaṃghaṃ pahūtāya yāguyā ca madhugoḷakena ca sahatthā santappetvā sampavāretvā bhagavantaṃ dhotahatthaṃ onītapattapāṇiṃ ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ||4||
pli-tv-kd6:24.5.1: ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho taṃ brāhmaṇaṃ bhagavā etad avoca: das'
pli-tv-kd6:24.6.3: yaguṃ dento āyuṃ deti, vaṇṇaṃ deti, sukhaṃ deti, balaṃ deti, paṭibhānaṃ deti, yāgu pītā khudaṃ paṭihanati, pipāsaṃ vinodeti, vātaṃ anulometi, vatthiṃ sodheti, āmāvasesaṃ pāceti.
pli-tv-kd6:24.6.8: āyuñ ca vaṇṇañ ca sukhaṃ balañ ca, |
pli-tv-kd6:24.6.13: tasmā hi yāguṃ alam eva dātum
pli-tv-kd6:24.7.1: atha kho bhagavā taṃ brāhmaṇaṃ imāhi gāthāhi anumoditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmi.
pli-tv-kd6:24.7.2: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd6:24.7.3: anujānāmi bhikkhave yāguñ ca madhugoḷakañ cā 'ti. ||7||24||
pli-tv-kd6:25.1.1: assosuṃ kho manussā: bhagavatā kira yāgu anuññātā madhugoḷakañ cā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd6:25.1.2: te kālass' eva bhojjayāguṃ paṭiyādenti madhugoḷakañ ca.
pli-tv-kd6:25.1.3: bhikkhū kālass' eva bhojjayāguyā dhātā madhugoḷakena ca bhattagge na cittarūpaṃ bhuñjanti.
pli-tv-kd6:25.1.4: tena kho pana samayena aññatarena taruṇapasannena mahāmattena svātanāya buddhapamukho bhikkhusaṃgho nimantito hoti.
pli-tv-kd6:25.1.5: atha kho tassa taruṇapasannassa mahāmattassa etad ahosi: yaṃ
pli-tv-kd6:25.1.6: nūnāhaṃ aḍḍhatelasannaṃ bhikkhusatānaṃ aḍḍhatelasāni maṃsapātīsatāni paṭiyādeyyaṃ ekamekassa bhikkhuno ekamekaṃ maṃsapātiṃ upanāmeyyan ti. ||1||
pli-tv-kd6:25.2.1: atha kho so taruṇapasanno mahāmatto tassā rattiyā accayena paṇītaṃ khādaniyaṃ bhojaniyaṃ paṭiyādāpetvā aḍḍhatelasāni ca maṃsapātīsatāni bhagavato kālaṃ ārocāpesi: kālo bhante, niṭṭhitaṃ bhattan ti.
pli-tv-kd6:25.2.2: atha kho bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya yena tassa taruṇapasannassa mahāmattassa nivesanaṃ ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṃghena. ||2||
pli-tv-kd6:25.3.1: atha kho so taruṇapasanno mahāmatto bhattagge bhikkhū parivisati.
pli-tv-kd6:25.3.3: thokaṃ āvuso dehi thokaṃ āvuso dehīti.
pli-tv-kd6:25.3.4: mā kho tumhe bhante ayaṃ taruṇapasanno mahāmatto 'ti thokaṃ-thokaṃ paṭigaṇhatha.
pli-tv-kd6:25.3.5: bahuṃ me khādaniyaṃ bhojaniyaṃ paṭiyattaṃ aḍḍhatelasāni ca maṃsapātīsatāni,
pli-tv-kd6:25.3.8: na kho mayaṃ āvuso etaṃkāraṇā thokaṃ-thokaṃ paṭigaṇhāma, api ca mayaṃ kālass' eva bhojjayāguyā dhātā madhugoḷakena ca, tena mayaṃ thokaṃ-thokaṃ paṭigaṇhāmā 'ti. ||3||
pli-tv-kd6:25.4.1: atha kho so taruṇapasanno mahāmatto ujjhāyati khīyati vipāceti:
pli-tv-kd6:25.4.2: kathaṃ hi nāma bhaddantā mayā nimantitā aññassa bhojjayāguṃ paribhuñjissanti, na cāhaṃ na paṭibalo yāvadatthaṃ dātun ti
pli-tv-kd6:25.4.3: kupito anattamano āsādanāpekkho bhikkhūnaṃ patte pūrento agamāsi bhuñjatha vā haratha vā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd6:25.4.4: atha kho so taruṇapasanno mahāmatto buddhapamukhaṃ bhikkhusaṃghaṃ paṇītena khādaniyena bhojaniyena sahatthā santappetvā sampavāretvā bhagavantaṃ bhuttāviṃ onītapattapāṇiṃ ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd6:25.4.5: ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho taruṇapasannaṃ mahāmattaṃ bhagavā dhammiyā kathāya sandassetvā samādapetvā samuttejetvā sampahaṃsetvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmi. ||4||
pli-tv-kd6:25.5.1: atha kho tassa taruṇapasannassa mahāmattassa acirapakkantassa bhagavato ahud eva kukkuccaṃ ahu vippaṭisāro:
pli-tv-kd6:25.5.2: alābhā vata me, na vata me lābhā, dulladdhaṃ vata me, na vata me suladdhaṃ,
pli-tv-kd6:25.5.3: yo 'haṃ kupito anattamano āsādanāpekkho bhikkhūnaṃ patte pūrento agamāsiṃ bhuñjatha vā haratha vā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd6:25.5.4: kiṃ nu kho mayā bahuṃ pasūtaṃ puññaṃ vā apuññaṃ vā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd6:25.5.5: atha kho so taruṇapasanno mahāmatto yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd6:25.5.6: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so taruṇapasanno mahāmatto bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd6:25.5.7: idha mayhaṃ bhante acirapakkantassa bhagavato ahud eva kukkuccaṃ ahu vippaṭisāro:
pli-tv-kd6:25.5.8: alābhā vata me, na vata me lābhā, dulladdhaṃ vata me, na vata me suladdhaṃ,
pli-tv-kd6:25.5.9: yo 'haṃ kupito anattamano āsādanāpekkho bhikkhūnaṃ patte pūrento agamāsiṃ bhuñjatha vā haratha vā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd6:25.5.10: kiṃ nu kho mayā bahuṃ pasūtaṃ puññaṃ vā apuññaṃ vā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd6:25.5.11: kiṃ nu kho mayā bhante bahuṃ pasūtaṃ puññaṃ vā apuññaṃ vā 'ti. ||5||
pli-tv-kd6:25.6.1: yadaggena tayā āvuso svātanāya buddhapamukho bhikkhusaṃgho nimantito, tadaggena te bahuṃ puññaṃ pasūtaṃ,
pli-tv-kd6:25.6.2: yadaggena te ekamekena bhikkhunā ekamekaṃ sitthaṃ paṭiggahitaṃ, tadaggena te bahuṃ puññaṃ pasūtaṃ, saggā te āraddhā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd6:25.6.3: atha kho so taruṇapasanno mahāmatto lābhā kira me, suladdhaṃ kira me, bahuṃ kira mayā puññaṃ pasūtaṃ, saggā kira me āraddhā 'ti
pli-tv-kd6:25.6.4: haṭṭho udaggo uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi. ||6||
pli-tv-kd6:25.7.1: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe bhikkhusaṃghaṃ sannipātāpetvā bhikkhū paṭipucchi:
pli-tv-kd6:25.7.2: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave bhikkhū aññatra nimantitā aññassa bhojjayāguṃ paribhuñjantīti.
pli-tv-kd6:25.7.5: hi nāma te bhikkhave moghapurisā aññatra nimantitā aññassa bhojjayāguṃ paribhuñjissanti.
pli-tv-kd6:25.7.6: n' etaṃ bhikkhave appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya.
pli-tv-kd6:25.7.7: vigarahitvā dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd6:25.7.8: na bhikkhave aññatra nimantitena aññassa bhojjayāgu paribhuñjitabbā.
pli-tv-kd6:26.1.1: atha kho bhagavā Andhakavinde yathābhirantaṃ viharitvā yena Rājagahaṃ tena cārikaṃ pakkāmi mahatā bhikkhusaṃghena saddhiṃ aḍḍhatelasehi bhikkhusatehi.
pli-tv-kd6:26.1.2: tena kho pana samayena Belaṭṭho Kaccāno Rājagahā Andhakavindaṃ addhānamaggapaṭipanno hoti pañcamattehi sakaṭasatehi sabbeh' eva guḷakumbhapūrehi.
pli-tv-kd6:26.1.3: addasa kho bhagavā Belaṭṭhaṃ Kaccānaṃ dūrato 'va āgacchantaṃ, disvāna maggā okkamma aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle nisīdi. ||1||
pli-tv-kd6:26.2.1: atha kho Belaṭṭho Kaccāno yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi.
pli-tv-kd6:26.2.2: ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho Belaṭṭho Kaccāno bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd6:26.2.3: icchām' ahaṃ bhante ekamekassa bhikkhuno ekamekaṃ guḷakumbhaṃ dātun ti.
pli-tv-kd6:26.2.4: tena hi tvaṃ Kaccāna ekaṃ yeva guḷakumbhaṃ āharā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd6:26.2.5: evaṃ bhante 'ti kho Belaṭṭho Kaccāno bhagavato paṭisuṇitvā ekaṃ yeva guḷakumbhaṃ ādāya yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd6:26.2.8: tena hi tvaṃ Kaccāna bhikkhūnaṃ guḷaṃ dehīti. ||2||
pli-tv-kd6:26.3.1: evaṃ bhante 'ti kho Belaṭṭho Kaccāno bhagavato paṭisuṇitvā bhikkhūnaṃ guḷaṃ datvā bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd6:26.3.2: dinno bhante bhikkhūnaṃ guḷo bahu cāyaṃ guḷo avasiṭṭho,
pli-tv-kd6:26.3.4: tena hi tvaṃ Kaccāna bhikkhūnaṃ guḷaṃ yāvadatthaṃ dehīti.
pli-tv-kd6:26.3.5: evaṃ bhante 'ti kho Belaṭṭho Kaccāno bhagavato paṭisuṇitvā bhikkhūnaṃ guḷaṃ yāvadatthaṃ datvā bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd6:26.3.6: dinno bhante bhikkhūnaṃ guḷo yāvadattho bahu cāyaṃ guḷo avasiṭṭho,
pli-tv-kd6:26.3.8: tena hi tvaṃ Kaccāna bhikkhū guḷehi santappehīti.
pli-tv-kd6:26.3.9: evaṃ bhante 'ti kho Belaṭṭho Kaccāno bhagavato paṭisuṇitvā bhikkhū guḷehi santappesi.
pli-tv-kd6:26.3.10: ekacce bhikkhū patte pi pūresuṃ parissāvanāni pi thavikāyo pi pūresuṃ. ||3||
pli-tv-kd6:26.4.1: atha kho Belaṭṭho Kaccāno bhikkhū guḷehi santappetvā bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd6:26.4.2: santappitā bhante bhikkhū guḷehi bahu cāyaṃ guḷo avasiṭṭho,
pli-tv-kd6:26.4.4: tena hi tvaṃ Kaccāna vighāsādānaṃ guḷaṃ dehīti.
pli-tv-kd6:26.4.5: evaṃ bhante 'ti kho Belaṭṭho Kaccāno bhagavato paṭisuṇitvā vighāsādānaṃ guḷaṃ datvā bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd6:26.4.6: dinno bhante vighāsādānaṃ guḷo bahu cāyaṃ guḷo avasiṭṭho,
pli-tv-kd6:26.4.8: tena hi tvaṃ Kaccāna vighāsādānaṃ yāvadatthaṃ guḷaṃ dehīti. ||4||
pli-tv-kd6:26.5.1: evaṃ bhante 'ti kho Belaṭṭho Kaccāno bhagavato paṭisuṇitvā vighāsādānaṃ yāvadatthaṃ guḷaṃ datvā bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd6:26.5.2: dinno bhante vighāsādānaṃ guḷo yāvadattho bahu cāyaṃ guḷo avasiṭṭho,
pli-tv-kd6:26.5.4: tena hi tvaṃ Kaccāna vighāsāde guḷehi santappehīti.
pli-tv-kd6:26.5.5: evaṃ bhante 'ti kho Belaṭṭho Kaccāno bhagavato paṭisuṇitvā vighāsāde guḷehi santappesi.
pli-tv-kd6:26.5.6: ekacce vighāsādā kolambe pi ghaṭe pi pūresuṃ piṭakāni pi ucchaṅge pi pūresuṃ. ||5||
pli-tv-kd6:26.6.1: atha kho Belaṭṭho Kaccāno vighāsāde guḷehi santappetvā bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd6:26.6.2: santappitā bhante vighāsādā guḷehi bahu cāyaṃ guḷo avasiṭṭho,
pli-tv-kd6:26.6.4: nāhaṃ taṃ Kaccāna passāmi sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya yassa so guḷo paribhutto sammā pariṇāmaṃ gaccheyya aññatra tathāgatassa vā tathāgatasāvakassa vā.
pli-tv-kd6:26.6.5: tena hi tvaṃ Kaccāna taṃ guḷaṃ appaharite vā chaḍḍehi appāṇake vā udake opilāpehīti.
pli-tv-kd6:26.6.6: evaṃ bhante 'ti kho Belaṭṭho Kaccāno bhagavato paṭisuṇitvā taṃ guḷaṃ appāṇake udake opilāpesi. ||6||
pli-tv-kd6:26.7.1: atha kho so guḷo udake pakkhitto cicciṭāyati ciṭiciṭāyati saṃdhūpāyati sampadhūpāyati.
pli-tv-kd6:26.7.2: seyyathāpi nāma phālo divasaṃ santatto udake pakkhitto cicciṭāyati ciṭiciṭāyati saṃdhūpāyati sampadhūpāyati,
pli-tv-kd6:26.7.3: evam eva so guḷo udake pakkhitto cicciṭāyati ciṭiciṭāyati saṃdhūpāyati sampadhūpāyati.
pli-tv-kd6:26.7.4: atha kho Belaṭṭho Kaccāno saṃviggo lomahaṭṭhajāto yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ||7||
pli-tv-kd6:26.8.1: ekamantaṃ nisinnassa kho Belaṭṭhassa Kaccānassa bhagavā anupubbikathaṃ kathesi seyyath' īdaṃ:
pli-tv-kd6:26.8.2: dānakathaṃ sīlakathaṃ saggakathaṃ kāmānaṃ ādīnavaṃ okāraṃ saṃkilesaṃ nekkhamme ānisaṃsaṃ pakāsesi.
pli-tv-kd6:26.8.3: yadā bhagavā aññāsi Belaṭṭhaṃ Kaccānaṃ kallacittaṃ muducittaṃ vinīvaraṇacittaṃ udaggacittaṃ pasannacittaṃ, atha yā buddhānaṃ sāmukkaṃsikā dhammadesanā taṃ pakāsesi --la--
pli-tv-kd6:26.8.4: evam eva Belaṭṭhassa Kaccānassa tasmiṃ yeva āsane virajaṃ vītamalaṃ dhammacakkhuṃ udapādi
pli-tv-kd6:26.8.5: yaṃ kiñci samudayadhammaṃ sabbaṃ taṃ nirodhadhamman ti. ||8||
pli-tv-kd6:26.9.1: atha kho Belaṭṭho Kaccāno diṭṭhadhammo pattadhammo viditadhammo pariyogāḷhadhammo tiṇṇavicikiccho vigatakathaṃkatho vesārajjappatto aparappaccayo satthu sāsane bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd6:26.9.4: evam eva bhagavatā anekapariyāyena dhammo pakāsito.
pli-tv-kd6:26.9.5: es' āhaṃ bhante bhagavantaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañ ca bhikkhusaṃghañ ca,
pli-tv-kd6:26.9.6: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhagavā dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatan ti. ||9||26||
pli-tv-kd6:27.1.1: atha kho bhagavā anupubbena cārikaṃ caramāno yena Rājagahaṃ tad avasari.
pli-tv-kd6:27.1.2: tatra sudaṃ bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Veḷuvane Kalandakanivāpe.
pli-tv-kd6:27.1.3: tena kho pana samayena Rājagahe guḷo ussanno hoti.
pli-tv-kd6:27.1.5: gilānass' eva bhagavatā guḷo anuññāto no agilānassā 'ti
pli-tv-kd6:27.1.8: anujānāmi bhikkhave gilānassa guḷaṃ, agilānassa guḷodakan ti. ||1||27||
pli-tv-kd6:28.1.1: atha kho bhagavā Rājagahe yathābhirantaṃ viharitvā yena Pāṭaligāmo tena cārikaṃ pakkāmi mahatā bhikkhusaṃghena saddhiṃ aḍḍhatelasehi bhikkhusatehi.
pli-tv-kd6:28.1.2: atha kho bhagavā anupubbena cārikaṃ caramāno yena Pāṭaligāmo tad avasari.
pli-tv-kd6:28.1.5: atha kho Pāṭaligāmikā upāsakā yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkamiṃsu, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu,
pli-tv-kd6:28.1.6: ekamantaṃ nisinne kho Pāṭaligāmike upāsake bhagavā dhammiyā kathāya sandassesi samādapesi samuttejesi sampahaṃsesi. ||1||
pli-tv-kd6:28.2.1: atha kho Pāṭaligāmikā upāsakā bhagavatā dhammiyā kathāya sandassitā samādapitā samuttejitā sampahaṃsitā bhagavantaṃ etad avocuṃ:
pli-tv-kd6:28.2.2: adhivāsetu no bhante bhagavā āvasathāgāraṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṃghenā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd6:28.2.4: atha kho Pāṭaligāmikā upāsakā bhagavato adhivāsanaṃ viditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā yena āvasathāgāraṃ ten' upasaṃkamiṃsu, upasaṃkamitvā sabbasanthariṃ santhataṃ āvasathāgāraṃ santharitvā āsanāni paññāpetvā udakamaṇikaṃ patiṭṭhāpetvā telapadīpaṃ āropetvā yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkamiṃsu, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu. ||2||
pli-tv-kd6:28.3.1: ekamantaṃ ṭhitā kho Pāṭaligāmikā upāsakā bhagavantaṃ etad avocuṃ: sabbasanthariṃ
pli-tv-kd6:28.3.6: yassa dāni bhante bhagavā kālaṃ maññatīti.
pli-tv-kd6:28.3.7: atha kho bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṃghena yena āvasathāgāraṃ ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā pāde pakkhāletvā āvasathāgāraṃ pavisitvā majjhimaṃ thambhaṃ nissāya puratthimābhimukho nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd6:28.3.8: bhikkhusaṃgho pi kho pāde pakkhāletvā āvasathāgāraṃ pavisitvā pacchimaṃ bhittiṃ nissāya puratthimābhimukho nisīdi bhagavantaṃ yeva purakkhatvā.
pli-tv-kd6:28.3.9: Pāṭaligāmikāpi kho upāsakā pāde pakkhāletvā āvasathāgāraṃ pavisitvā puratthimaṃ bhittiṃ nissāya pacchimābhimukhā nisīdiṃsu bhagavantaṃ yeva purakkhatvā. ||3||
pli-tv-kd6:28.3.10: atha kho bhagavā Pāṭaligāmike upāsake āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd6:28.4.1: pañc' ime gahapatayo ādīnavā dussīlassa sīlavipattiyā.
pli-tv-kd6:28.4.3: idha gahapatayo dussīlo sīlavipanno pamādādhikaraṇaṃ mahatiṃ bhogajāniṃ nigacchati,
pli-tv-kd6:28.4.5: puna ca paraṃ gahapatayo dussīlassa sīlavipannassa pāpako kittisaddo abbhuggacchati,
pli-tv-kd6:28.4.7: puna ca paraṃ gahapatayo dussīlo sīlavipanno yañ ñad eva parisaṃ upasaṃkamati yadi khattiyaparisaṃ yadi brāhmaṇaparisaṃ yadi gahapatiparisaṃ yadi samaṇaparisaṃ avisārado upasaṃkamati maṅkubhūto,
pli-tv-kd6:28.4.9: puna ca paraṃ gahapatayo dussīlo sīlavipanno sammūḷho kālaṃ karoti,
pli-tv-kd6:28.4.11: puna ca paraṃ gahapatayo dussīlo sīlavipanno kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati,
pli-tv-kd6:28.4.13: ime kho gahapatayo pañca ādīnavā dussīlassa sīlavipattiyā. ||4||
pli-tv-kd6:28.5.1: pañc' ime gahapatayo ānisaṃsā sīlavato sīlasampadāya.
pli-tv-kd6:28.5.3: idha gahapatayo sīlavā sīlasampanno appamādādhikaraṇaṃ mahantaṃ bhogakkhandhaṃ adhigacchati,
pli-tv-kd6:28.5.5: puna ca paraṃ gahapatayo sīlavato sīlasampannassa kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggacchati,
pli-tv-kd6:28.5.7: puna ca paraṃ gahapatayo sīlavā sīlasampanno yañ ñad eva parisaṃ upasaṃkamati yadi khattiyaparisaṃ yadi brāhmaṇaparisaṃ yadi gahapatiparisaṃ yadi samaṇaparisaṃ visārado upasaṃkamati amaṅkubhūto,
pli-tv-kd6:28.5.9: puna ca paraṃ gahapatayo sīlavā sīlasampanno asammūḷho kālaṃ karoti,
pli-tv-kd6:28.5.11: puna ca paraṃ gahapatayo sīlavā sīlasampanno kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjati,
pli-tv-kd6:28.5.13: ime kho gahapatayo pañca ānisaṃsā sīlavato sīlasampadāyā 'ti. ||5||
pli-tv-kd6:28.6.1: atha kho bhagavā Pāṭaligāmike upāsake bahud eva rattiṃ dhammiyā kathāya sandassetvā samādapetvā samuttejetvā sampahaṃsetvā uyyojesi:
pli-tv-kd6:28.6.4: evaṃ bhante 'ti kho Pāṭaligāmikā upāsakā bhagavato paṭisuṇitvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkamiṃsu. ||6||
pli-tv-kd6:28.7.1: atha kho bhagavā acirapakkantesu Pāṭaligāmikesu upāsakesu suññāgāraṃ pāvisi.
pli-tv-kd6:28.7.2.1: tena kho pana samayena Sunidhavassakārā Magadhamahāmattā Pāṭaligāme nagaraṃ māpenti Vajjīnaṃ paṭibāhāya.
pli-tv-kd6:28.7.3: addasa kho bhagavā rattiyā paccūsasamayaṃ paccuṭṭhāya dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena sambahulā devatāyo Pāṭaligāme vatthūni parigaṇhantiyo.
pli-tv-kd6:28.7.4: yasmiṃ padese mahesakkhā devatā vatthūni parigaṇhanti, mahesakkhānaṃ tattha rājūnaṃ rājamahāmattānaṃ cittāni namanti nivesanāni māpetuṃ,
pli-tv-kd6:28.7.5: yasmiṃ padese majjhimā devatā vatthūni parigaṇhanti, majjhimānaṃ tattha rājūnaṃ rājamahāmattānaṃ cittāni namanti nivesanāni māpetuṃ,
pli-tv-kd6:28.7.6: yasmiṃ padese nīcā devatā vatthūni parigaṇhanti, nīcānaṃ tattha rājūnaṃ rājamahāmattānaṃ cittāni namanti nivesanāni māpetuṃ. ||7||
pli-tv-kd6:28.7.7: atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ Ānandaṃ āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd6:28.7.8: ke nu kho te Ānanda Pāṭaligāme nagaraṃ māpentīti.
pli-tv-kd6:28.8.1: Sunidhavassakārā bhante Magadhamahāmattā Pāṭaligāme nagaraṃ māpenti Vajjīnaṃ paṭibāhāyā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd6:28.8.2: seyyathāpi Ānanda devehi Tāvatiṃsehi saddhiṃ mantetvā
pli-tv-kd6:28.8.3: evam eva kho Ānanda Sunidhavassakārā Magadhamahāmattā Pāṭaligāme nagaraṃ māpenti Vajjīnaṃ paṭibāhāya.
pli-tv-kd6:28.8.4: idhāhaṃ Ānanda rattiyā paccūsasamayaṃ paccuṭṭhāya addasaṃ dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena sambahulā devatāyo . . .
pli-tv-kd6:28.8.7: nīcānaṃ tattha rājūnaṃ rājamahāmattānaṃ cittāni namanti nivesanāni māpetuṃ.
pli-tv-kd6:28.8.8: yāvatā Ānanda ariyaṃ āyatanaṃ yāvatā vaṇippatho idaṃ agganagaraṃ bhavissati Pāṭaliputtaṃ puṭabhedanaṃ.
pli-tv-kd6:28.8.9: Pāṭaliputtassa kho Ānanda tayo antarāyā bhavissanti,
pli-tv-kd6:28.8.10: aggito vā udakato vā abbhantarato vā mithubhedā 'ti. ||8||
pli-tv-kd6:28.9.1: atha kho Sunidhavassakārā Magadhamahāmattā yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkamiṃsu, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodiṃsu, sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sāraṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu,
pli-tv-kd6:28.10.1: ekamantaṃ ṭhitā kho Sunidhavassakārā Magadhamahāmattā bhagavantaṃ etad avocuṃ:
pli-tv-kd6:28.10.2: adhivāsetu no bhavaṃ Gotamo ajjatanāya bhattaṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṃghenā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd6:28.10.4: atha kho Sunidhavassakārā Magadhamahāmattā bhagavato adhivāsanaṃ viditvā pakkamiṃsu. ||9||
pli-tv-kd6:28.10.5: atha kho Sunidhavassakārā Magadhamahāmattā paṇītaṃ khādaniyaṃ bhojaniyaṃ paṭiyādāpetvā bhagavato kālaṃ ārocāpesuṃ: kālo bho Gotama, niṭṭhitaṃ bhattan ti.
pli-tv-kd6:28.10.6: atha kho bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya yena Sunidhavassakārānaṃ Magadhamahāmattānaṃ parivesanā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṃghena.
pli-tv-kd6:28.10.7: atha kho Sunidhavassakārā Magadhamahāmattā buddhapamukhaṃ bhikkhusaṃghaṃ paṇītena khādaniyena bhojaniyena sahatthā santappetvā sampavāretvā bhagavantaṃ bhuttāviṃ onītapattapāṇiṃ ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu,
pli-tv-kd6:28.10.8: ekamantaṃ nisinne kho Sunidhavassakāre Magadhamahāmatte bhagavā imāhi gāthāhi anumodi: ||10||
pli-tv-kd6:28.11.13: atha kho bhagavā Sunidhavassakāre Magadhamahāmatte imāhi gāthāhi anumoditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmi. ||11||
pli-tv-kd6:28.12.1: tena kho pana samayena Sunidhavassakārā Magadhamahāmattā bhagavantaṃ piṭṭhito-piṭṭhito anubaddhā honti,
pli-tv-kd6:28.12.2: yen' ajja samaṇo Gotamo dvārena nikkhamissati taṃ Gotamadvāraṃ nāma bhavissati,
pli-tv-kd6:28.12.3: yena titthena Gaṅgaṃ nadiṃ uttarissati taṃ Gotamatitthaṃ nāma bhavissatīti.
pli-tv-kd6:28.12.4: atha kho bhagavā yena dvārena nikkhami taṃ Gotamadvāraṃ nāma ahosi.
pli-tv-kd6:28.12.5: atha kho bhagavā yena Gaṅgā nadī ten' upasaṃkami.
pli-tv-kd6:28.12.6: tena kho pana samayena Gaṅgā nadī pūrā hoti samatitthikā kākapeyyā.
pli-tv-kd6:28.12.7: manussā aññe nāvaṃ pariyesanti aññe uḷumpaṃ pariyesanti aññe kullaṃ bandhanti orā pāraṃ gantukāmā. ||12||
pli-tv-kd6:28.13.1: addasa kho bhagavā te manusse aññe nāvaṃ pariyesante aññe uḷumpaṃ pariyesante aññe kullaṃ bandhante orā pāraṃ gantukāme, disvāna seyyathāpi nāma balavā puriso sammiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ sammiñjeyya, evam eva Gaṅgāya nadiyā orimatīre antarahito pārimatīre paccuṭṭhāsi saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṃghena.
pli-tv-kd6:28.13.2: atha kho bhagavā etam atthaṃ viditvā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi:
pli-tv-kd6:29.1.1: atha kho bhagavā yena Koṭigāmo ten' upasaṃkami.
pli-tv-kd6:29.1.4: catunnaṃ bhikkhave ariyasaccānaṃ ananubodhā appaṭivedhā evam idaṃ dīgham addhānaṃ sandhāvitaṃ saṃsaritaṃ mamañ c' eva tumhākañ ca.
pli-tv-kd6:29.1.6: dukkhassa bhikkhave ariyasaccassa ananubodhā appaṭivedhā evam idaṃ dīghaṃ addhānaṃ sandhāvitaṃ saṃsaritaṃ mamañ c' eva tumhākañ ca.
pli-tv-kd6:29.1.9: ananubodhā appaṭivedhā evam idaṃ dīgham addhānaṃ sandhāvitaṃ saṃsaritaṃ mamañ c' eva tumhākañ ca. ||1||
pli-tv-kd6:29.2.1: tayidaṃ bhikkhave dukkhaṃ ariyasaccaṃ anubuddhaṃ paṭividdhaṃ, dukkhasamudayaṃ ariyasaccaṃ anubuddhaṃ paṭividdhaṃ, dukkhanirodhaṃ ariyasaccaṃ anubuddhaṃ paṭividdhaṃ, dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ariyasaccaṃ anubuddhaṃ paṭividdhaṃ, ucchinnā bhavataṇhā, khīṇā bhavanetti, n' atthi dāni punabbhavo 'ti.
pli-tv-kd6:30.1.3: atha kho Ambapālī gaṇikā bhadrāni -bhadrāni yānāni yojāpetvā bhadraṃ yānaṃ abhirūhitvā bhadrehi-bhadrehi yānehi Vesāliyā niyyāsi bhagavantaṃ dassanāya.
pli-tv-kd6:30.1.4: yāvatikā yānassa bhūmi yānena gantvā yānā paccorohitvā pattikā 'va yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ||1||
pli-tv-kd6:30.2.1: ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho Ambapāliṃ gaṇikaṃ bhagavā dhammiyā kathāya sandassesi samādapesi samuttejesi sampahaṃsesi.
pli-tv-kd6:30.2.2: atha kho Ambapālī gaṇikā bhagavatā dhammiyā kathāya sandassitā samādapitā samuttejitā sampahaṃsitā bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd6:30.2.3: adhivāsetu me bhante bhagavā svātanāya bhattaṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṃghenā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd6:30.2.5: atha kho Ambapālī gaṇikā bhagavato adhivāsanaṃ viditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi. ||2||
pli-tv-kd6:30.3.3: atha kho Vesālikā Licchavī bhadrāni-bhadrāni yānāni yojāpetvā bhadraṃ-bhadraṃ yānaṃ abhirūhitvā bhadrehi -bhadrehi yānehi Vesāliyā niyyāsuṃ bhagavantaṃ dassanāya.
pli-tv-kd6:30.3.4: appekacce Licchavī nīlā honti nīlavaṇṇā nīlavatthā nīlālaṃkārā, appekacce Licchavī pītā honti pītavaṇṇā pītavatthā pītālaṃkārā, appekacce Licchavī lohitakā honti lohitvaṇṇā lohitavatthā lohitālaṃkārā, appekacce Licchavī odātā honti odātavaṇṇā odātavatthā odātālaṃkārā.
pli-tv-kd6:30.3.5: atha kho Ambapālī gaṇikā daharānaṃ-daharānaṃ Licchavīnaṃ īsāya īsaṃ yugena yugaṃ cakkena cakkaṃ akkhena akkhaṃ paṭivaṭṭesi. ||3||
pli-tv-kd6:30.4.1: atha kho te Licchavī Ambapāliṃ gaṇikaṃ etad avocuṃ:
pli-tv-kd6:30.4.2: kissa je Ambapāli daharānaṃ-daharānaṃ Licchavīnaṃ īsāya īsaṃ yugena yugaṃ cakkena cakkaṃ akkhena akkhaṃ paṭivaṭṭesīti.
pli-tv-kd6:30.4.3: tathā hi pana mayā ayyaputtā svātanāya buddhapamukho bhikkhusaṃgho nimantito 'ti.
pli-tv-kd6:30.4.4: dehi je Ambapāli amhākaṃ etaṃ bhattaṃ satasahassenā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd6:30.4.5: sace pi ayyaputtā Vesāliṃ sāhāraṃ dajjeyyātha, n' eva dajjāhaṃ taṃ bhattan ti.
pli-tv-kd6:30.4.6: atha kho te Licchavī aṅgulī poṭhesuṃ:
pli-tv-kd6:30.4.7: jit' amhā vata bho ambakāya, parājit' amhā vata bho ambakāyā 'ti. ||4||
pli-tv-kd6:30.5.1: atha kho te Licchavī yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkamiṃsu.
pli-tv-kd6:30.5.2: addasa kho bhagavā te Licchavī dūrato 'va āgacchante, disvāna bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd6:30.5.3: yehi bhikkhave bhikkhūhi devā Tāvatiṃsā adiṭṭhapubbā, oloketha bhikkhave Licchaviparisaṃ
pli-tv-kd6:30.5.6: atha kho te Licchavī yāvatikā yānassa bhūmi yānena gantvā yānā paccorohitvā pattikā 'va yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkamiṃsu,
pli-tv-kd6:30.5.8: ekamantaṃ nisinne kho te Licchavī bhagavā dhammiyā kathāya sandassesi samādapesi samuttejesi sampahaṃsesi.
pli-tv-kd6:30.5.9: atha kho te Licchavī bhagavatā dhammiyā kathāya sandassitā samādapitā samuttejitā sampahaṃsitā bhagavantaṃ etad avocuṃ:
pli-tv-kd6:30.5.10: adhivāsetu no bhante bhagavā svātanāya bhattaṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṃghenā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd6:30.5.11: adhivuttho 'mhi Licchavī svātanāya Ambapāliyā gaṇikāya bhattan ti.
pli-tv-kd6:30.5.12: atha kho te Licchavī aṅgulī poṭhesuṃ:
pli-tv-kd6:30.5.13: jit' amhā vata kho ambakāya, parājit' amhā vata bho ambakāyā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd6:30.5.14: atha kho te Licchavī bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkamiṃsu. ||5||
pli-tv-kd6:30.6.1: atha kho bhagavā Koṭigāme yathābhirantaṃ viharitvā yena Nātikā ten' upasaṃkami.
pli-tv-kd6:30.6.2: tatra sudaṃ bhagavā Ñātike viharati Giñjakāvasathe.
pli-tv-kd6:30.6.3: atha kho Ambapālī gaṇikā tassā rattiyā accayena sake ārāme paṇītaṃ khādaniyaṃ bhojaniyaṃ paṭiyādāpetvā bhagavato kālaṃ ārocāpesi: kālo bhante, niṭṭhitaṃ bhattan ti.
pli-tv-kd6:30.6.4: atha kho bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaram ādāya yena Ambapāliyā gaṇikāya parivesanā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṃghena.
pli-tv-kd6:30.6.5: atha kho Ambapālī gaṇikā buddhapamukhaṃ bhikkhusaṃghaṃ paṇītena khādaniyena bhojaniyena sahatthā santappetvā sampavāretvā bhagavantaṃ bhuttāviṃ onītapattapāṇiṃ ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho Ambapālī gaṇikā bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd6:30.6.6: imāhaṃ bhante Ambapālivanaṃ buddhapamukhassa bhikkhusaṃghassa dammīti.
pli-tv-kd6:30.6.8: atha kho bhagavā Ambapāliṃ gaṇikaṃ dhammiyā kathāya sandassetvā . . . sampahaṃsetvā uṭṭhāyāsanā yena Mahāvanaṃ ten' upasaṃkami.
pli-tv-kd6:30.6.9: tatra sudaṃ bhagavā Vesāliyaṃ viharati Mahāvane Kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ. ||6||30|| Licchavibhāṇavāraṃ niṭṭhitaṃ.
pli-tv-kd6:31.1.1: tena kho pana samayena abhiññātā-abhiññātā Licchavī santhāgāre sannisinnā sannipatitā anekapariyāyena buddhassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsanti, dhammassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsanti, saṃghassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsanti.
pli-tv-kd6:31.1.2: tena kho pana samayena Sīho senāpati nigaṇṭhasāvako tassaṃ parisāyaṃ nisinno hoti.
pli-tv-kd6:31.1.3: atha kho Sīhassa senāpatissa etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd6:31.1.4: nissaṃsayaṃ kho so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho bhavissati, tathā h' ime abhiññātā -abhiññātā Licchavī santhāgāre sannisinnā sannipatitā anekapariyāyena buddhassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsanti, dhammassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsanti, saṃghassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsanti.
pli-tv-kd6:31.1.5: yaṃ nūnāhaṃ taṃ bhagavantaṃ dassanāya upasaṃkameyyaṃ arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhan ti. ||1||
pli-tv-kd6:31.2.1: atha kho Sīho senāpati yena nigaṇṭho Nātaputto ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā nigaṇṭhaṃ Nātaputtaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd6:31.2.2: icchām' ahaṃ bhante samaṇaṃ Gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṃkamitun ti.
pli-tv-kd6:31.2.3: kiṃ pana tvaṃ Sīha kiriyavādo samāno akiriyavādaṃ samaṇaṃ Gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṃkamissasi.
pli-tv-kd6:31.2.4: samaṇo hi Sīha Gotamo akiriyavādo akiriyāya dhammaṃ deseti tena ca sāvake vinetīti.
pli-tv-kd6:31.2.5: atha kho Sīhassa senāpatissa yo ahosi gamikābhisaṃkhāro bhagavantaṃ dassanāya so paṭippassambhi. ||2||
pli-tv-kd6:31.3.1: dutiyam pi kho abhiññātā-abhiññātā Licchavī santhāgāre sannisinnā sannipatitā anekapariyāyena buddhassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsanti, dhammassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsanti, saṃghassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsanti.
pli-tv-kd6:31.3.2: dutiyam pi kho Sīhassa senāpatissa etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd6:31.3.5: dutiyam pi kho Sīho senāpati yena nigaṇṭho Nātaputto . . . vineti. dutiyam pi kho Sīhassa senāpatissa . . . paṭippassambhi. tatiyam pi kho abhiññātā . . .
pli-tv-kd6:31.3.6: vaṇṇaṃ bhāsanti. tatiyam pi kho Sīhassa senāpatissa etad ahosi: nissaṃsayaṃ . . . saṃghassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsanti.
pli-tv-kd6:31.3.13: me karissanti nigaṇṭhā apalokitā vā anapalokitvā vā.
pli-tv-kd6:31.3.14: yaṃ nūnāhaṃ anapaloketvā 'va nigaṇṭhe taṃ bhagavantaṃ dassanāya upasaṃkameyyaṃ arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhan ti. ||3||
pli-tv-kd6:31.4.1: atha kho Sīho senāpati pañcahi rathasatehi divādivassa Vesāliyā niyyāsi bhagavantaṃ dassanāya.
pli-tv-kd6:31.4.2: yāvatikā yānassa bhūmi yānena gantvā yānā paccorohitvā pattiko 'va yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd6:31.4.3: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho Sīho senāpati bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd6:31.4.4: sutaṃ metaṃ bhante: akiriyavādo samaṇo Gotamo, akiriyāya dhammaṃ deseti tena ca sāvake vinetīti.
pli-tv-kd6:31.4.5: ye te bhante evam āhaṃsu: akiriyavādo samaṇo Gotamo, akiriyāya dhammaṃ deseti tena ca sāvake vinetīti,
pli-tv-kd6:31.4.6: kacci te bhante bhagavato vuttavādī na ca bhagavantaṃ abhūtena abbhācikkhanti dhammassa ca anudhammaṃ vyākaronti. na ca koci sahadhammiko vādānuvādo gārayhaṭṭhānaṃ āgacchati,
pli-tv-kd6:31.4.7: anabbhakkhātukāmā hi mayaṃ bhante bhagavantan ti. ||4||
