pli-tv-kd6:31.10.1: evaṃ vutte Sīho senāpati bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd6:31.10.3: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhagavā dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatan ti.
pli-tv-kd6:31.10.4: anuvijjakāraṃ kho Sīha karohi, anuvijjakāro tumhādisānaṃ ñātamanussānaṃ sādhu hotīti.
pli-tv-kd6:31.10.5: iminā p' āhaṃ bhante bhagavato bhiyyosomattāya attamano abhiraddho yaṃ maṃ bhagavā evam āha:
pli-tv-kd6:31.10.6: anuvijjakāraṃ kho Sīha karohi, anuvijjakāro tumhādisānaṃ ñātamanussānaṃ sādhu hotīti.
pli-tv-kd6:31.10.7: mamaṃ hi bhante aññatitthiyā sāvakaṃ labhitvā kevalakappaṃ Vesāliṃ patākaṃ parihareyyuṃ Sīho amhākaṃ senāpati sāvakattaṃ upagato 'ti.
pli-tv-kd6:31.10.8: atha ca pana maṃ bhagavā evam āha:
pli-tv-kd6:31.10.9: anuvijjakāraṃ kho Sīha karohi, anuvijjakāro tumhādisānaṃ ñātamanussānaṃ sādhu hotīti.
pli-tv-kd6:31.10.10: es' āhaṃ bhante dutiyam pi bhagavantaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañ ca bhikkhusaṃghañ ca,
pli-tv-kd6:31.10.11: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhagavā dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatan ti. ||10||
pli-tv-kd6:31.11.1: dīgharattaṃ kho te Sīha nigaṇṭhānaṃ opānabhūtaṃ kulaṃ yena nesaṃ upagatānaṃ piṇḍapātaṃ dātabbaṃ maññeyyāsīti.
pli-tv-kd6:31.11.2: iminā p' āhaṃ bhante bhagavato bhiyyosomattāya attamano abhiraddho yaṃ maṃ bhagavā evam āha:
pli-tv-kd6:31.11.3: dīgharattaṃ kho te Sīha nigaṇṭhānaṃ opānabhūtaṃ kulaṃ yena nesaṃ upagatānaṃ piṇḍapātaṃ dātabbaṃ maññeyyāsīti.
pli-tv-kd6:31.11.4: sutaṃ metaṃ bhante: samaṇo Gotamo evam āha:
pli-tv-kd6:31.11.5: mayham eva dānaṃ dātabbaṃ, na aññesaṃ dānaṃ dātabbaṃ, mayham eva sāvakānaṃ dānaṃ dātabbaṃ, na aññesaṃ sāvakānaṃ dānaṃ dātabbaṃ,
pli-tv-kd6:31.11.6: mayham eva dinnaṃ mahapphalaṃ, na aññesaṃ dinnaṃ mahapphalaṃ, mayham eva sāvakānaṃ dinnaṃ mahapphalaṃ, na aññesaṃ sāvakānaṃ dinnaṃ mahapphalan ti.
pli-tv-kd6:31.11.7: atha ca pana maṃ bhagavā nigaṇṭhesu pi dāne samādapeti.
pli-tv-kd6:31.11.8: api ca bhante mayam ettha kālaṃ jānissāma.
pli-tv-kd6:31.11.9: es' āhaṃ bhante tatiyam pi bhagavantaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi . . .
pli-tv-kd6:31.12.1: atha kho bhagavā Sīhassa senāpatissa anupubbikathaṃ kathesi seyyath' īdaṃ:
pli-tv-kd6:31.12.4: adhivāsetu me bhante bhagavā svātanāya bhattaṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṃghenā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd6:31.12.6: atha kho Sīho senāpati bhagavato adhivāsanaṃ viditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
pli-tv-kd6:31.12.7: atha kho Sīho senāpati aññataraṃ purisaṃ āṇāpesi:
pli-tv-kd6:31.12.9: atha kho Sīho senāpati tassā rattiyā accayena paṇītaṃ khādaniyaṃ bhojaniyaṃ paṭiyādāpetvā bhagavato kālaṃ ārocāpesi: kālo bhante, niṭṭhitaṃ bhattan ti.
pli-tv-kd6:31.12.10: atha kho bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya yena Sīhassa senāpatissa nivesanaṃ ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṃghena. ||12||
pli-tv-kd6:31.13.1: tena kho pana samayena sambahulā nigaṇṭhā Vesāliyaṃ rathiyāya rathiyaṃ siṅghāṭakena siṅghāṭakaṃ bāhā paggayha kandanti:
pli-tv-kd6:31.13.2: ajja Sīhena senāpatinā thullaṃ pasuṃ vadhitvā samaṇassa Gotamassa bhattaṃ kataṃ, taṃ samaṇo Gotamo jānaṃ uddissakataṃ maṃsaṃ paribhuñjati paṭiccakamman ti.
pli-tv-kd6:31.13.3: atha kho aññataro puriso yena Sīho senāpati ten' upasaṃkami , upasaṃkamitvā Sīhassa senāpatissa upakaṇṇake ārocesi:
pli-tv-kd6:31.13.4: yagghe bhante jāneyyāsi, ete sambahulā nigaṇṭhā Vesāliyaṃ rathiyāya rathiyaṃ siṅghāṭakena siṅghāṭakaṃ bāhā paggayha kandanti:
pli-tv-kd6:31.13.5: ajja . . . uddissakataṃ maṃsaṃ paribhuñjati paṭiccakamman ti.
pli-tv-kd6:31.13.6: alaṃ ayyo dīgharattam pi te āyasmantā avaṇṇakāmā buddhassa avaṇṇakāmā dhammassa avaṇṇakāmā saṃghassa,
pli-tv-kd6:31.13.7: na ca pana te āyasmantā jīranti taṃ bhagavantaṃ asatā tucchā musā 'va abhūtena abbhācikkhantā,
pli-tv-kd6:31.13.8: na ca mayaṃ jīvitahetu pi sañcicca pāṇaṃ jīvitā voropeyyāmā 'ti. ||13||
pli-tv-kd6:31.14.1: atha kho Sīho senāpati buddhapamukhaṃ bhikkhusaṃghaṃ paṇītena khādaniyena bhojaniyena sahatthā santappetvā sampavāretvā bhagavantaṃ bhuttāviṃ onītapattapāṇiṃ ekamantaṃ nisīdi,
pli-tv-kd6:31.14.2: ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho Sīhaṃ senāpatiṃ bhagavā dhammiyā kathāya sandassetvā . . . sampahaṃsetvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmi.
pli-tv-kd6:31.14.3: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd6:31.14.4: na bhikkhave jānaṃ uddissakataṃ maṃsaṃ paribhuñjitabbam.
pli-tv-kd6:31.14.6: anujānāmi bhikkhave tikoṭiparisuddhaṃ macchamaṃsaṃ adiṭṭhaṃ asutaṃ aparisaṅkitan ti. ||14||31||
pli-tv-kd6:32.1.1: tena kho pana samayena Vesālī subhikkhā hoti susassā sulabhapiṇḍā sukarā uñchena paggahena yāpetuṃ.
pli-tv-kd6:32.1.2: atha kho bhagavato rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi:
pli-tv-kd6:32.1.3: yāni tāni mayā bhikkhūnaṃ anuññātāni dubbhikkhe dussasse dullabhapiṇḍe anto vutthaṃ anto pakkaṃ sāmaṃ pakkaṃ uggahitapaṭiggahitakaṃ tato nīhataṃ purebhattaṃ paṭiggahitaṃ vanaṭṭhaṃ pokkharaṭṭhaṃ, ajjāpi nu kho tāni bhikkhū paribhuñjantīti.
pli-tv-kd6:32.1.4: atha kho bhagavā sāyaṇhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito āyasmantaṃ Ānandaṃ āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd6:32.1.5: yāni tāni Ānanda mayā bhikkhūnaṃ anuññātāni . . . paribhuñjantīti.
pli-tv-kd6:32.2.1: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd6:32.2.2: yāni tāni bhikkhave mayā bhikkhūnaṃ anuññātāni dubbhikkhe dussasse dullabhapiṇḍe anto vutthaṃ anto pakkaṃ sāmaṃ pakkaṃ uggahitapaṭiggahitakaṃ tato nīhataṃ purebhattaṃ paṭiggahitaṃ vanaṭṭhaṃ pokkharaṭṭhaṃ, tān' āhaṃ ajjatagge paṭikkhipāmi.
pli-tv-kd6:32.2.3: na bhikkhave anto vutthaṃ anto pakkaṃ sāmaṃ pakkaṃ uggahitapaṭiggahitakaṃ paribhuñjitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd6:32.2.5: na ca bhikkhave tato nīhataṃ purebhattaṃ paṭiggahitaṃ vanaṭṭhaṃ pokkharaṭṭhaṃ bhuttāvinā pavāritena anatirittaṃ paribhuñjitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd6:33.1.1: tena kho pana samayena jānapadā manussā bahuṃ loṇam pi telam pi taṇḍulam pi khādaniyam pi sakaṭesu āropetvā bahārāmakoṭṭhake sakaṭaparivaṭṭaṃ karitvā acchanti yadā paṭipāṭiṃ labhissāma tadā bhattaṃ karissāmā 'ti,
pli-tv-kd6:33.1.3: atha kho te manussā yenāyasmā Ānando ten' upasaṃkamiṃsu, upasaṃkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Ānandaṃ etad avocuṃ: idha bhante Ānanda bahuṃ loṇam pi telam pi taṇḍulam pi khādaniyam pi sakaṭesu āropetvā tiṭṭhanti mahā ca megho uggato. kathaṃ nu kho bhante Ānanda paṭipajjitabban ti.
pli-tv-kd6:33.1.4: atha kho āyasmā Ānando bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesi. ||1||
pli-tv-kd6:33.2.1: tena h' Ānanda saṃgho paccantimaṃ vihāraṃ kappiyabhūmiṃ sammannitvā tattha vāsetu yaṃ saṃgho ākaṅkhati vihāraṃ vā aḍḍhayogaṃ vā pāsādaṃ vā hammiyaṃ vā guhaṃ vā.
pli-tv-kd6:33.2.5: yadi saṃghassa pattakallaṃ, saṃgho itthannāmaṃ vihāraṃ kappiyabhūmiṃ sammanneyya.
pli-tv-kd6:33.2.9: yassāyasmato khamati itthannāmassa vihārassa kappiyabhūmiyā sammuti, so tuṇh' assa,
pli-tv-kd6:33.2.12: khamati saṃghassa, tasmā tuṇhī, evaṃ etaṃ dhārayāmīti. ||2||
pli-tv-kd6:33.3.1: tena kho pana samayena manussā tatth' eva sammutiyā kappiyabhūmiyā yāguyo pacanti bhattāni pacanti sūpāni sampādenti maṃsāni koṭṭenti kaṭṭhāni phālenti.
pli-tv-kd6:33.3.2: assosi kho bhagavā rattiyā paccūsasamayaṃ paccuṭṭhāya uccāsaddaṃ mahāsaddaṃ kākoravasaddaṃ, sutvāna āyasmantaṃ Ānandaṃ āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd6:33.3.3: kiṃ nu kho so Ānanda uccāsaddo mahāsaddo kākoravasaddo 'ti. ||3||
pli-tv-kd6:33.4.1: etarahi bhante manussā tatth' eva sammutiyā kappiyabhūmiyā yāguyo pacanti bhattāni pacanti sūpāni sampādenti maṃsāni koṭṭenti kaṭṭhāni phālenti,
pli-tv-kd6:33.4.2: so eso bhagavā uccāsaddo mahāsaddo kākoravasaddo 'ti.
pli-tv-kd6:33.4.3: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd6:33.5.1: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā Yasojo gilāno hoti,
pli-tv-kd6:33.5.8: ussāvanantikaṃ gonisādikaṃ gahapatiṃ sammutin ti. ||5||33|| catuvīsatibhāṇavāraṃ niṭṭhitaṃ.
pli-tv-kd6:34.1.1: tena kho pana samayena Bhaddiyanagare Meṇḍako gahapati paṭivasati,
pli-tv-kd6:34.1.3: sīsaṃ nahāyitvā dhaññāgāraṃ sammajjāpetvā bahidvāre 'va nisīdati, antalikkhā dhaññassa dhārā opatitvā dhaññāgāraṃ pūreti.
pli-tv-kd6:34.1.5: ekañ ñeva āḷhakathālikaṃ upanisīditvā ekañ ca sūpavyañjanakaṃ dāsakammakaraporisaṃ bhattena parivisati, na tāva taṃ khīyati yāva sā na vuṭṭhāti.
pli-tv-kd6:34.1.7: ekañ ñeva sahassatthavikaṃ gahetvā dāsakammakaraporisassa chammāsikaṃ vetanaṃ deti, na tāva taṃ khīyati yāv' assa hatthagatā. ||1||
pli-tv-kd6:34.2.2: ekañ ñeva catudoṇikaṃ piṭakaṃ upanisīditvā dāsakammakaraporisassa chammāsikaṃ bhattaṃ deti, na tāva taṃ khīyati yāva sā na vuṭṭhāti.
pli-tv-kd6:34.2.4: ekena naṅgalena kasantassa satta sītāyo gacchanti. ||2||
pli-tv-kd6:34.3.1: assosi kho rājā Māgadho Seniyo Bimbisāro:
pli-tv-kd6:34.3.2: amhākaṃ kira vijite Bhaddiyanagare Meṇḍako gahapati paṭivasati,
pli-tv-kd6:34.3.4: sīsaṃ nahāyitvā dhaññāgāraṃ sammajjāpetvā bahidvāre nisīdati, antalikkhā dhaññassa dhārā opatitvā dhaññāgāraṃ pūreti.
pli-tv-kd6:34.3.6: ekañ ñeva āḷhakathālikaṃ upanisīditvā ekañ ca sūpavyañjanakaṃ dāsakammakaraporisaṃ bhattena parivisati, na tāva taṃ khīyati yāva sā na vuṭṭhāti.
pli-tv-kd6:34.3.8: ekañ ñeva sahassatthavikaṃ gahetvā dāsakammakaraporisassa chammāsikaṃ vetanaṃ deti, na tāva taṃ khīyati yāv' assa hatthagatā. ||3||
pli-tv-kd6:34.4.2: ekañ ñeva catudoṇikaṃ piṭakaṃ upanisīditvā dāsakammakaraporisassa chammāsikaṃ bhattaṃ deti, na tāva taṃ khīyati yāva sā na vuṭṭhāti.
pli-tv-kd6:34.4.4: ekena naṅgalena kasantassa satta sītāyo gacchantīti. ||4||
pli-tv-kd6:34.5.1: atha kho rājā Māgadho Seniyo Bimbisāro aññataraṃ sabbatthakaṃ mahāmattaṃ āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd6:34.5.2: amhākaṃ kira bhaṇe vijite Bhaddiyanagare Meṇḍako gahapati paṭivasati,
pli-tv-kd6:34.5.10: yathā mayā sāmaṃ diṭṭho evaṃ tava diṭṭho bhavissatīti.
pli-tv-kd6:34.5.11: evaṃ devā 'ti kho so mahāmatto rañño Māgadhassa Seniyassa Bimbisārassa paṭisuṇitvā caturaṅginiyā senāya yena Bhaddiyaṃ tena pāyāsi. ||5||
pli-tv-kd6:34.6.1: anupubbena yena Bhaddiyaṃ yena Meṇḍako gahapati ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā Meṇḍakaṃ gahapatiṃ etad avoca: ahaṃ
pli-tv-kd6:34.6.10: atha kho Meṇḍako gahapati sīsaṃ nahāyitvā dhaññāgāraṃ sammajjāpetvā bahidvāre nisīdi, antalikkhā dhaññassa dhārā opatitvā dhaññāgāraṃ pūresi.
pli-tv-kd6:34.7.1: atha kho Meṇḍako gahapati bhariyaṃ āṇāpesi:
pli-tv-kd6:34.7.2: tena hi caturaṅginiṃ senaṃ bhattena parivisāhīti.
pli-tv-kd6:34.7.3: atha kho Meṇḍakassa gahapatissa bhariyā ekañ ñeva āḷhakathālikaṃ upanisīditvā ekañ ca sūpavyañjanakaṃ caturaṅginiṃ senaṃ bhattena parivisi, na tāva taṃ khīyati yāva sā na vuṭṭhāti.
pli-tv-kd6:34.7.4: diṭṭho te gahapati bhariyāya pi iddhānubhāvo,
pli-tv-kd6:34.8.1: atha kho Meṇḍako gahapati puttaṃ āṇāpesi:
pli-tv-kd6:34.8.2: tena hi tāta caturaṅginiyā senāya chammāsikaṃ vetanaṃ dehīti.
pli-tv-kd6:34.8.3: atha kho Meṇḍakassa gahapatissa putto ekañ ñeva sahassatthavikaṃ gahetvā caturaṅginiyā senāya chammāsikaṃ vetanaṃ adāsi, na tāva taṃ khīyati yāv' assa hatthagatā.
pli-tv-kd6:34.8.4: diṭṭho te gahapati puttassa pi iddhānubhavo,
pli-tv-kd6:34.9.1: atha kho Meṇḍako gahapati suṇisaṃ āṇāpesi:
pli-tv-kd6:34.9.2: tena hi caturaṅginiyā senāya chammāsikaṃ bhattaṃ dehīti.
pli-tv-kd6:34.9.3: atha kho Meṇḍakassa gahapatissa suṇisā ekañ ñeva catudoṇikaṃ piṭakaṃ upanisīditvā caturaṅginiyā senāya chammāsikaṃ bhattaṃ adāsi, na tāva taṃ khīyati yāva sā na vuṭṭhāti.
pli-tv-kd6:34.9.4: diṭṭho te gahapati suṇisāya pi iddhānubhāvo,
pli-tv-kd6:34.9.6: mayhaṃ kho sāmi dāsassa iddhānubhāvo khette passitabbo 'ti.
pli-tv-kd6:34.9.7: alaṃ gahapati diṭṭho te dāsassa pi iddhānubhāvo 'ti.
pli-tv-kd6:34.9.8: atha kho so mahāmatto caturaṅginiyā senāya punad eva Rājagahaṃ paccāgacchi,
pli-tv-kd6:34.9.9: yena rājā Māgadho Seniyo Bimbisāro ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā rañño Māgadhassa Seniyassa Bimbisārassa etam atthaṃ ārocesi. ||9||
pli-tv-kd6:34.10.1: atha kho bhagavā Vesāliyaṃ yathābhirantaṃ viharitvā yena Bhaddiyaṃ tena cārikaṃ pakkāmi mahatā bhikkhusaṃghena saddhiṃ aḍḍhatelasehi bhikkhusatehi.
pli-tv-kd6:34.10.2: atha kho bhagavā anupubbena cārikaṃ caramāno yena Bhaddiyaṃ tad avasari.
pli-tv-kd6:34.10.3: tatra sudaṃ bhagavā Bhaddiye viharati Jātiyāvane. ||10||
pli-tv-kd6:34.11.2: samaṇo khalu bho Gotamo Sakyaputto Sakyakulā pabbajito Bhaddiyaṃ anuppatto Bhaddiye viharati Jātiyāvane.
pli-tv-kd6:34.11.3: taṃ kho pana bhagavantaṃ Gotamaṃ evaṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato
pli-tv-kd6:34.11.4: iti pi so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā,
pli-tv-kd6:34.11.5: so imaṃ lokaṃ sadevakaṃ samārakaṃ sabrahmakaṃ sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiṃ pajaṃ sadevamanussaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedeti,
pli-tv-kd6:34.11.6: so dhammaṃ deseti ādikalyāṇaṃ majjhe kalyāṇaṃ pariyosānakalyāṇaṃ satthaṃ savyañjanaṃ kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ pakāseti.
pli-tv-kd6:34.11.7: sādhu kho pana tathārūpānaṃ arahataṃ dassanaṃ hotīti. ||11||
pli-tv-kd6:34.12.1: atha kho Meṇḍako gahapati bhadrāni-bhadrāni yānāni yojāpetvā bhadraṃ yānaṃ abhirūhitvā bhadrehi-bhadrehi yānehi Bhaddiyā niyyāsi bhagavantaṃ dassanāya.
pli-tv-kd6:34.12.2: addasaṃsu kho sambahulā titthiyā Meṇḍakaṃ gahapatiṃ dūrato 'va āgacchantaṃ, disvāna Meṇḍakaṃ gahapatiṃ etad avocuṃ:
pli-tv-kd6:34.12.4: gacchām' ahaṃ bhante bhagavantaṃ samaṇaṃ Gotamaṃ dassanāyā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd6:34.12.5: kiṃ pana tvaṃ gahapati kiriyavādo samāno akiriyavādaṃ samaṇaṃ Gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṃkamissasi,
pli-tv-kd6:34.12.6: samaṇo hi gahapati Gotamo akiriyavādo akiriyāya dhammaṃ deseti tena ca sāvake vinetīti. ||12||
pli-tv-kd6:34.13.1: atha kho Meṇḍakassa gahapatissa etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd6:34.13.2: nissaṃsayaṃ kho so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho bhavissati yathā yime titthiyā usuyyantīti,
pli-tv-kd6:34.13.3: yāvatikā yānassa bhūmi yānena gantvā yānā paccorohitvā pattiko 'va yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd6:34.13.4: ekamantaṃ nisinnassa kho Meṇḍakassa gahapatissa bhagavā anupubbikathaṃ kathesi seyyath' īdaṃ:
pli-tv-kd6:34.13.6: aparappaccayo satthu sāsane bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd6:34.13.8: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhagavā dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatan ti,
pli-tv-kd6:34.13.9: adhivāsetu ca me bhante bhagavā svātanāya bhattaṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṃghenā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd6:34.14.1: atha kho Meṇḍako gahapati bhagavato adhivāsanaṃ viditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
pli-tv-kd6:34.14.2: atha kho Meṇḍako gahapati tassā rattiyā accayena paṇītaṃ khādaniyaṃ bhojaniyaṃ paṭiyādāpetvā bhagavato kālaṃ ārocāpesi: kālo bhante, niṭṭhitaṃ bhattan ti.
pli-tv-kd6:34.14.3: atha kho bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya yena Meṇḍakassa gahapatissa nivesanaṃ ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṃghena. ||14||
pli-tv-kd6:34.15.1: atha kho Meṇḍakassa gahapatissa bhariyā ca putto ca suṇisā ca dāso ca yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkamiṃsu, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu.
pli-tv-kd6:34.15.6: ete mayaṃ bhante bhagavantaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāma dhammañ ca bhikkhusaṃghañ ca,
pli-tv-kd6:34.15.7: upāsake no bhagavā dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupete saraṇaṃ gate 'ti. ||15||
pli-tv-kd6:34.16.1: atha kho Meṇḍako gahapati buddhapamukhaṃ bhikkhusaṃghaṃ paṇītena khādaniyena bhojaniyena sahatthā santappetvā sampavāretvā bhagavantaṃ bhuttāviṃ onītapattapāṇiṃ ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho Meṇḍako gahapati bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd6:34.16.2: yāva bhante bhagavā Bhaddiye viharati, tāva ahaṃ buddhapamukhassa bhikkhusaṃghassa dhuvabhattenā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd6:34.16.3: atha kho bhagavā Meṇḍakaṃ gahapatiṃ dhammiyā kathāya sandassetvā . . . sampahaṃsetvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmi. ||16||
pli-tv-kd6:34.17.1: atha kho bhagavā Bhaddiye yathābhirantaṃ viharitvā Meṇḍakaṃ gahapatiṃ anāpucchā yena Aṅguttarāpo tena cārikaṃ pakkāmi mahatā bhikkhusaṃghena saddhiṃ aḍḍhatelasehi bhikkhusatehi.
pli-tv-kd6:34.17.3: bhagavā kira yena Aṅguttarāpo tena cārikaṃ pakkanto mahatā . . . bhikkhusatehīti.
pli-tv-kd6:34.17.4: atha kho Meṇḍako gahapati dāse ca kammakare ca āṇāpesi:
pli-tv-kd6:34.17.5: tena hi bhaṇe bahuṃ loṇam pi telam pi taṇḍulam pi khādaniyam pi sakaṭesu āropetvā āgacchatha, aḍḍhatelasāni ca gopālakasatāni aḍḍhatelasāni dhenusatāni ādāya āgacchantu, yattha bhagavantaṃ passissāma tattha taruṇena khīrena bhojessāmā 'ti. ||17||
pli-tv-kd6:34.18.1: atha kho Meṇḍako gahapati bhagavantaṃ antarā magge kantāre sambhāvesi.
pli-tv-kd6:34.18.2: atha kho Meṇḍako gahapati yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi.
pli-tv-kd6:34.18.3: ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho Meṇḍako gahapati bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd6:34.18.4: adhivāsetu me bhante bhagavā svātanāya bhattaṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṃghenā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd6:34.18.6: atha kho Meṇḍako gahapati bhagavato adhivāsanaṃ viditvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
pli-tv-kd6:34.18.7: atha kho Meṇḍako gahapati tassā rattiyā accayena paṇītaṃ khādaniyaṃ bhojaniyaṃ paṭiyādāpetvā bhagavato kālaṃ ārocāpesi: kālo bhante, niṭṭhitaṃ bhattan ti. ||18||
pli-tv-kd6:34.19.1: atha kho bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya yena Meṇḍakassa gahapatissa parivesanā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṃghena.
pli-tv-kd6:34.19.2: atha kho Meṇḍako gahapati aḍḍhatelasāni gopālakasatāni āṇāpesi:
pli-tv-kd6:34.19.3: tena hi bhaṇe ekamekaṃ dhenuṃ gahetvā ekamekassa bhikkhuno upatiṭṭhatha taruṇena khīrena bhojessāmā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd6:34.19.4: atha kho Meṇḍako gahapati buddhapamukhaṃ bhikkhusaṃghaṃ paṇītena khādaniyena bhojaniyena sahatthā santappesi sampavāresi taruṇena ca khīrena.
pli-tv-kd6:34.20.1: atha kho Meṇḍako gahapati buddhapamukhaṃ bhikkhusaṃghaṃ paṇītena khādaniyena bhojaniyena sahatthā santappetvā sampavāretvā taruṇena ca khīrena bhagavantaṃ bhuttāviṃ onītapattapāṇiṃ ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd6:34.20.2: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho Meṇḍako gahapati bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd6:34.20.3: santi bhante maggā kantārā appodakā appabhakkhā na sukarā apātheyyena gantuṃ.
pli-tv-kd6:34.20.4: sādhu bhante bhagavā bhikkhūnaṃ pātheyyaṃ anujānātū 'ti.
pli-tv-kd6:34.20.5: atha kho bhagavā Meṇḍakaṃ gahapatiṃ dhammiyā kathāya sandassetvā . . . sampahaṃsetvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmi. ||20||
pli-tv-kd6:34.21.1: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd6:34.21.4: santi bhikkhave maggā kantārā appodakā appabhakkhā na sukarā apātheyyena gantuṃ.
pli-tv-kd6:34.21.5: anujānāmi bhikkhave pātheyyaṃ pariyesituṃ, taṇḍulo taṇḍulatthikena, muggo muggatthikena, māso māsatthikena, loṇaṃ loṇatthikena, guḷo guḷatthikena, telaṃ telatthikena, sappi sappitthikena.
pli-tv-kd6:34.21.6: santi bhikkhave manussā saddhā pasannā, te kappiyakārakānaṃ hatthe hiraññaṃ upanikkhipanti
pli-tv-kd6:34.21.7: iminā ayyassa yaṃ kappiyaṃ taṃ dethā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd6:34.21.8: anujānāmi bhikkhave yaṃ tato kappiyaṃ taṃ sādituṃ.
pli-tv-kd6:34.21.9: na tv evāhaṃ bhikkhave kenaci pariyāyena jātarūparajataṃ sāditabbaṃ pariyesitabban ti vadāmīti. ||21||34||
pli-tv-kd6:35.1.1: atha kho bhagavā anupubbena cārikaṃ caramāno yena Āpaṇaṃ tad avasari.
pli-tv-kd6:35.1.3: samaṇo khalu bho Gotamo Sakyaputto Sakyakulā pabbajito Āpaṇaṃ anuppatto Āpaṇe viharati. taṃ kho pana bhagavantaṃ Gotamaṃ evaṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato --la--
pli-tv-kd6:35.1.4: sādhu kho pana tathārūpānaṃ arahataṃ dassanaṃ hotīti.
pli-tv-kd6:35.1.5: atha kho Keniyassa jaṭilassa etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd6:35.1.6: kiṃ nu kho ahaṃ samaṇassa Gotamassa harāpeyyan ti. ||1||
pli-tv-kd6:35.2.1: atha kho Keniyassa jaṭilassa etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd6:35.2.2: ye pi kho te brāhmaṇānaṃ pubbakā isayo mantānaṃ kattāro mantānaṃ pavattāro yesam idaṃ etarahi brāhmaṇā porāṇaṃ mantapadaṃ gītaṃ pavuttaṃ samihitaṃ tad anugāyanti tad anubhāsanti bhāsitaṃ anubhāsanti vācitam anuvācenti, seyyath' īdaṃ:
pli-tv-kd6:35.2.3: Aṭṭhako Vāmako Vāmadevo Vessāmitto Yamataggi Aṅgiraso Bhāradvājo Vāseṭṭho Kassapo Bhagu, rattūparatā viratā vikālabhojanā, te evarūpāni pānāni sādiyiṃsu, ||2||
pli-tv-kd6:35.3.1: samaṇo pi Gotamo rattūparato virato vikālabhojanā, arahati samaṇo pi Gotamo evarūpāni pānāni saditun ti,
pli-tv-kd6:35.3.2: pahūtaṃ pānaṃ paṭiyādāpetvā kājehi gāhāpetvā yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi,
pli-tv-kd6:35.3.3: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sāraṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi.
pli-tv-kd6:35.3.4: ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho Keniyo jaṭilo bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd6:35.3.5: paṭigaṇhātu me bhavaṃ Gotamo pānan ti.
pli-tv-kd6:35.4.1: atha kho Keniyo jaṭilo buddhapamukhaṃ bhikkhusaṃghaṃ pahūtehi pānehi sahatthā santappetvā sampavāretvā bhagavantaṃ dhotahatthaṃ onītapattapāṇiṃ ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd6:35.4.2: ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho Keniyaṃ jaṭilaṃ bhagavā dhammiyā kathāya sandassesi . . . sampahaṃsesi.
pli-tv-kd6:35.4.3: atha kho Keniyo jaṭilo bhagavatā dhammiyā kathāya sandassito . . . sampahaṃsito bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd6:35.4.4: adhivāsetu me bhavaṃ Gotamo svātanāya bhattaṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṃghenā 'ti. ||4||
pli-tv-kd6:35.5.1: mahā kho Keniya bhikkhusaṃgho aḍḍhatelasāni bhikkhusatāni tvañ ca brāhmaṇesu abhippasanno 'ti.
pli-tv-kd6:35.5.2: dutiyam pi kho Keniyo jaṭilo bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd6:35.5.3: kiñ cāpi bho Gotama mahā bhikkhusaṃgho aḍḍhatelasāni bhikkhusatāni ahañ ca brāhmaṇesu abhippasanno. adhivāsetu me . . . bhikkhusaṃghenā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd6:35.5.5: tatiyam pi kho Keniyo jaṭilo bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd6:35.5.8: atha kho Keniyo jaṭilo bhagavato adhivāsanaṃ viditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmi. ||5||
pli-tv-kd6:35.6.1: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd6:35.6.3: ambapānaṃ jambupānaṃ cocapānaṃ mocapānaṃ madhup. muddikāp. sālukap. phārusakapānaṃ.
pli-tv-kd6:35.6.4: anujānāmi bhikkhave sabbaṃ phalarasaṃ ṭhapetvā dhaññaphalarasaṃ.
pli-tv-kd6:35.6.5: anujānāmi bhikkhave sabbaṃ pattarasaṃ ṭhapetvā ḍākarasaṃ.
pli-tv-kd6:35.6.6: anujānāmi bhikkhave sabbaṃ puppharasaṃ ṭhapetvā madhukapuppharasaṃ.
pli-tv-kd6:35.7.1: atha kho Keniyo jaṭilo tassā rattiyā accayena sake assame paṇītaṃ khādaniyaṃ bhojaniyaṃ paṭiyādāpetvā bhagavato kālaṃ ārocāpesi: kālo bho Gotama, niṭṭhitaṃ bhattan ti.
pli-tv-kd6:35.7.2: atha kho bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya yena Keniyassa jaṭilassa assamo ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṃghena.
pli-tv-kd6:35.7.3: atha kho Keniyo jaṭilo buddhapamukhaṃ bhikkhusaṃghaṃ paṇītena khādaniyena bhojaniyena sahatthā santappetvā sampavāretvā bhagavantaṃ bhuttāviṃ onītapattapāṇiṃ ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ||7||
pli-tv-kd6:35.8.1: ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho Keniyaṃ jaṭilaṃ bhagavā imāhi gāthāhi anumodi:
pli-tv-kd6:35.8.10: atha kho bhagavā Keniyaṃ jaṭilaṃ imāhi gāthāhi anumoditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmi. ||8||35||
pli-tv-kd6:36.1.1: atha kho bhagavā Āpaṇe yathābhirantaṃ viharitvā yena Kusinārā tena cārikaṃ pakkāmi mahatā bhikkhusaṃghena saddhiṃ aḍḍhatelasehi bhikkhusatehi.
pli-tv-kd6:36.1.2: assosuṃ kho Kosinārakā Mallā: bhagavā kira Kusināraṃ āgacchati mahatā bhikkhusaṃghena saddhiṃ aḍḍhatelasehi bhikkhusatehīti.
pli-tv-kd6:36.1.3: te saṃgaraṃ akaṃsu: yo bhagavato paccuggamanaṃ na karissati pañca satāni daṇḍo 'ti.
pli-tv-kd6:36.1.4: tena kho pana samayena Rojo Mallo āyasmato Ānandassa sahāyo hoti.
pli-tv-kd6:36.1.5: atha kho bhagavā anupubbena cārikaṃ caramāno yena Kusinārā tad avasari. ||1||
pli-tv-kd6:36.2.1: atha kho Kosinārakā Mallā bhagavato paccuggamanaṃ akaṃsu.
pli-tv-kd6:36.2.2: atha kho Rojo Mallo bhagavato paccuggamanaṃ karitvā yenāyasmā Ānando ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā āyasmantam Ānandaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi.
pli-tv-kd6:36.2.3: ekamantaṃ ṭhitaṃ kho Rojaṃ Mallaṃ āyasmā Ānando etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd6:36.2.4: uḷāraṃ kho te idaṃ āvuso Roja yaṃ tvaṃ bhagavato paccuggamanaṃ akāsīti.
pli-tv-kd6:36.2.5: nāhaṃ bhante Ānanda bahukato buddhena vā dhammena vā saṃghena vā,
pli-tv-kd6:36.2.6: api ca ñātīhi saṃgaro kato yo bhagavato paccuggamanaṃ na karissati pañca satāni daṇḍo 'ti.
pli-tv-kd6:36.2.7: sa kho ahaṃ bhante Ānanda ñātīnaṃ daṇḍabhayā evāhaṃ bhagavato paccuggamanaṃ akāsin ti.
pli-tv-kd6:36.2.8: atha kho āyasmā Ānando anattamano ahosi: kathaṃ hi nāma Rojo Mallo evaṃ vakkhatīti. ||2||
pli-tv-kd6:36.3.1: atha kho āyasmā Ānando yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd6:36.3.2: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Ānando bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd6:36.3.3: ayaṃ bhante Rojo Mallo abhiññāto ñātamanusso.
pli-tv-kd6:36.3.4: mahiddhiyo kho pana evarūpānaṃ ñātamanussānaṃ imasmiṃ dhammavinaye pasādo.
pli-tv-kd6:36.3.5: sādhu bhante bhagavā tathā karotu yathā Rojo Mallo imasmiṃ dhammavinaye pasīdeyyā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd6:36.3.6: na kho taṃ Ānanda dukkaraṃ tathāgatena yathā Rojo Mallo imasmiṃ dhammavinaye pasīdeyyā 'ti. ||3||
pli-tv-kd6:36.4.1: atha kho bhagavā Rojaṃ Mallaṃ mettena cittena pharitvā uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāraṃ pāvisi.
pli-tv-kd6:36.4.2: atha kho Rojo Mallo bhagavatā mettena cittena phuṭṭho seyyathāpi nāma gāvī taruṇavacchā
pli-tv-kd6:36.4.3: evam eva vihārena vihāraṃ pariveṇena pariveṇaṃ upasaṃkamitvā bhikkhū pucchati:
pli-tv-kd6:36.4.4: kahaṃ nu kho bhante etarahi so bhagavā viharati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho, dassanakāmā hi mayaṃ taṃ bhagavantaṃ arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhan ti.
pli-tv-kd6:36.4.5: es' āvuso Roja vihāro saṃvutadvāro, tena appasaddo upasaṃkamitvā ataramāno ālindaṃ pavisitvā ukkāsitvā aggaḷaṃ ākoṭehi, vivarissati te bhagavā dvāran ti. ||4||
pli-tv-kd6:36.5.1: atha kho Rojo Mallo yena so vihāro saṃvutadvāro tena appasaddo upasaṃkamitvā ataramāno ālindaṃ pavisitvā ukkāsitvā aggaḷaṃ ākoṭesi, vivari bhagavā dvāraṃ.
pli-tv-kd6:36.5.2: atha kho Rojo Mallo vihāraṃ pavisitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd6:36.5.3: ekamantaṃ nisinnassa kho Rojassa Mallassa bhagavā anupubbikathaṃ kathesi seyyath' īdaṃ:
pli-tv-kd6:36.5.5: aparappaccayo satthu sāsane bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd6:36.5.6: sādhu bhante ayyā mamañ ñeva paṭigaṇheyyuṃ cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhāraṃ no aññesan ti.
pli-tv-kd6:36.5.7: yesaṃ kho Roja sekhena ñāṇena sekhena dassanena dhammo diṭṭho seyyathāpi tayā tesam pi evaṃ hoti:
pli-tv-kd6:36.5.8: aho nūna ayyā amhākañ ñeva paṭigaṇheyyuṃ cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhāraṃ no aññesan ti.
pli-tv-kd6:36.5.9: tena hi Roja tava c' eva paṭigaṇhissanti aññesañ cā 'ti. ||5||
pli-tv-kd6:36.6.1: tena kho pana samayena Kusinārāyaṃ paṇītānaṃ bhattānaṃ bhattapaṭipāṭi adhiṭṭhitā hoti.

pli-tv-kd6:36.8.1: atha kho Rojo Mallo buddhapamukhaṃ bhikkhusaṃghaṃ pahūtehi ḍākehi ca piṭṭhakhādaniyehi ca sahatthā santappetvā sampavāretvā bhagavantaṃ dhotahatthaṃ onītapattapāṇiṃ ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd6:36.8.2: ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho Rojaṃ Mallaṃ bhagavā dhammiyā kathāya sandassetvā . . . sampahaṃsetvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmi.
pli-tv-kd6:36.8.3: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd6:36.8.4: anujānāmi bhikkhave sabbañ ca ḍākam sabbañ ca piṭṭhakhādaniyan ti. ||8||36||
pli-tv-kd6:37.1.1: atha kho bhagavā Kusinārāyaṃ yathābhirantaṃ viharitvā yena Ātumā tena cārikaṃ pakkāmi mahatā bhikkhusaṃghena saddhiṃ aḍḍhatelasehi bhikkhusatehi.
pli-tv-kd6:37.1.2: tena kho pana samayena aññataro vuḍḍhapabbajito Ātumāyaṃ paṭivasati nahāpitapubbo,
pli-tv-kd6:37.1.3: tassa dve dārakā honti mañjukā paṭibhāneyyakā dakkhā pariyodātasippā sake ācariyake nahāpitakamme. ||1||
pli-tv-kd6:37.2.1: assosi kho so vuḍḍhapabbajito: bhagavā kira Ātumaṃ āgacchati mahatā bhikkhusaṃghena saddhiṃ aḍḍhatelasehi bhikkhusatehīti.
pli-tv-kd6:37.2.2: atha kho so vuḍḍhapabbajito te dārake etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd6:37.2.3: bhagavā kira tāta Ātumaṃ āgacchati mahatā bhikkhusaṃghena saddhiṃ aḍḍhatelasehi bhikkhusatehi.
pli-tv-kd6:37.2.4: gacchatha tumhe tāta khurabhaṇḍaṃ ādāya nāḷiyāvāpakena anugharakaṃ-anugharakaṃ āhiṇḍatha loṇam pi telam pi taṇḍulam pi khādaniyam pi saṃharatha, bhagavato āgatassa yāgupānaṃ karissāmā 'ti. ||2||
pli-tv-kd6:37.3.1: evaṃ tātā 'ti kho te dārakā tassa vuḍḍhapabbajitassa paṭisuṇitvā khurabhaṇḍaṃ ādāya nāḷiyāvāpakena anugharakaṃ-anugharakaṃ āhiṇḍanti loṇam pi telam pi taṇḍulam pi khādaniyam pi saṃharantā.
pli-tv-kd6:37.3.2: manussā te dārake mañjuke paṭibhāneyyake passitvā ye pi na kārāpetukāmā te pi kārāpenti kārāpetvāpi bahuṃ denti.
pli-tv-kd6:37.3.3: atha kho te dārakā bahuṃ loṇam pi telam pi taṇḍulam pi khādaniyam pi saṃhariṃsu. ||3||
pli-tv-kd6:37.4.1: atha kho bhagavā anupubbena cārikaṃ caramāno yena Ātumā tad avasari.
pli-tv-kd6:37.4.2: tatra sudaṃ bhagavā Ātumāyaṃ viharati Bhūsāgāre.
pli-tv-kd6:37.4.3: atha kho so vuḍḍhapabbajito tassā rattiyā accayena pahūtaṃ yāguṃ paṭiyādāpetvā bhagavato upanāmesi
pli-tv-kd6:37.4.4: paṭigaṇhātu me bhante bhagavā yāgun ti.
pli-tv-kd6:37.4.7: atha kho bhagavā taṃ vuḍḍhapabbajitaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd6:37.4.9: atha kho so vuḍḍhapabbajito bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesi. ||4||
pli-tv-kd6:37.5.2: ananucchaviyaṃ moghapurisa ananulomikaṃ appaṭirūpaṃ assāmaṇakaṃ akappiyaṃ akaraṇīyaṃ.
pli-tv-kd6:37.5.3: kathaṃ hi nāma tvaṃ moghapurisa pabbajito akappiye samādapessasi.
pli-tv-kd6:37.5.4: n' etaṃ moghapurisa appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya.
pli-tv-kd6:37.5.5: vigarahitvā dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd6:37.5.6: na bhikkhave pabbajitena akappiye samādapetabbaṃ. yo samādapeyya, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-kd6:37.5.7: na ca bhikkhave nahāpitapubbena khurabhaṇḍaṃ pariharitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd6:38.1.1: atha kho bhagavā Ātumāyaṃ yathābhirantaṃ viharitvā yena Sāvatthi tena cārikaṃ pakkāmi.
pli-tv-kd6:38.1.2: anupubbena cārikaṃ caramāno yena Sāvatthi tad avasari.
pli-tv-kd6:38.1.3: tatra sudaṃ bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-kd6:38.1.4: tena kho pana samayena Sāvatthiyaṃ bahuṃ phalakhādaniyaṃ ussannaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-kd6:38.1.6: kiṃ nu kho bhagavatā phalakhādaniyaṃ anuññātaṃ kiṃ ananuññātan ti.

pli-tv-kd6:39.1.3: saṃghikāni bhikkhave bījāni puggalikāya bhūmiyā ropitāni bhāgaṃ datvā paribhuñjitabbāni,
